Name: i18n Auto Updater
Description:
[url=https://github.com/CNCUMC/i18n-Auto-Updater]GitHub[/url] | [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/447]NexusMods[/url]

[i]Automatically downloads and updates localization files from GitHub repositories.[/i]
[line]
[size=4]Overview[/size]

[b]i18n Auto Updater[/b] is a BepInEx plugin for [b]Casualties Unknown[/b] that automatically checks for and downloads
localization files from GitHub repositories. It supports single file downloads or wildcard mode to fetch all files from
a repository.

[line]
[size=4]Features[/size]

[list]
[*][b]Automatic Updates[/b] — Checks for updates on game startup and at configurable intervals[/*]
[*][b]Single File Mode[/b] — Download a specific localization file[/*]
[*][b]Wildcard Mode[/b] — Download all files from a repository using '[font=Monaco,Consolas,'Lucida Console','Courier New',serif]*'[/font][/*]
[*][b]SHA-based Caching[/b] — Only downloads files when content has changed (compares GitHub SHA hashes)[/*]
[*][b]Smart Exclusions[/b] — Automatically skips [font=Monaco,Consolas,'Lucida Console','Courier New',serif].github[/font], [font=Monaco,Consolas,'Lucida Console','Courier New',serif].gitattributes[/font], [font=Monaco,Consolas,'Lucida Console','Courier New',serif].gitignore[/font], [font=Monaco,Consolas,'Lucida Console','Courier New',serif]README.md[/font],
[font=Monaco,Consolas,'Lucida Console','Courier New',serif]TranslationNotes.md[/font][/*]
[*][b]Persistent Cache[/b] — Stores file SHA hashes in a JSON cache file to avoid redundant downloads[/*]
[*][b]Cancellation Support[/b] — Gracefully stops background tasks when the plugin is destroyed[/*]
[/list][line]
[size=4]Installation[/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx]BepInEx 5.x[/url] for Casualties Unknown.[/*]
[*]Download the latest version.[/*]
[*]Place [font=Monaco,Consolas,'Lucida Console','Courier New',serif]i18nAutoUpdater.dll[/font] in your [font=Monaco,Consolas,'Lucida Console','Courier New',serif]BepInEx/plugins/i18n Auto Updater/[/font] folder.[/*]
[/list][line]
[size=4]Configuration[/size]

Configuration is stored in [font=Monaco,Consolas,'Lucida Console','Courier New',serif]BepInEx/config/org.cncumc.i18nautoupdater.cfg[/font].

[list]
[*]Repo Path: 'Orsoniks/scavgame-locale' GitHub repository path, format: 'owner/repo'[/*]
[*]File Path: 'zh-CN.json' Path to localization file (relative to repo root), use `*` to download all files[/*]
[*]Branch: 'main' Branch name to download from[/*]
[*]Auto Check On Startup: 'true' Automatically check for updates on game startup[/*]
[*]Check Interval (Hours): '6' Interval between automatic update checks (in hours)[/*]
[/list][line]
[size=4]How It Works[/size]

[size=3]Single File Mode[/size]

When [font=Monaco,Consolas,'Lucida Console','Courier New',serif]File Path[/font] is set to a specific file (e.g., [font=Monaco,Consolas,'Lucida Console','Courier New',serif]zh-CN.json[/font]):

[list=1]
[*]The plugin queries the GitHub API to get the file's SHA hash[/*]
[*]Compares it with the cached SHA from previous downloads[/*]
[*]If the SHA matches → skips download (logs: [font=Monaco,Consolas,'Lucida Console','Courier New',serif]Cache analysis: SHA matches cache[/font])[/*]
[*]If the SHA differs → downloads the file and updates the cache[/*]
[/list][size=3]Wildcard Mode[/size]

When [font=Monaco,Consolas,'Lucida Console','Courier New',serif]File Path[/font] is set to [font=Monaco,Consolas,'Lucida Console','Courier New',serif]*[/font]:

[list=1]
[*]Fetches the repository's file list from GitHub API[/*]
[*]Filters out excluded files and folders[/*]
[*]For each remaining file:
[list]
[*]Checks if the SHA matches the cache[/*]
[*]Downloads only if changed or new[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*]Logs a summary: [font=Monaco,Consolas,'Lucida Console','Courier New',serif]Batch update complete: X updated, Y skipped, Z failed[/font][/*]
[/list][size=3]Cache File[/size]

The cache is stored in [font=Monaco,Consolas,'Lucida Console','Courier New',serif]BepInEx/cache/org.cncumc.i18nautoupdater.json[/font] as a JSON file:

[code]{
"Orsoniks/scavgame-locale/main/zh-CN.json": {
"sha": "a1b2c3d4e5f6...",
"lastUpdate": "2026-07-14T10:00:00Z",
"filePath": "zh-CN.json"
}
}[/code][line]
[size=4]Excluded Files[/size]

The following files and folders are automatically excluded in wildcard mode:

Folder: '.github'         
File: '.gitattributes, '.gitignore', 'README.md', 'translationNotes.md'

[line]
[size=4]Log Messages[/size]

[list]
[*]'i18n Auto Updater loaded!': Plugin initialized[/*]
[*]'Wildcard mode: Fetching file list from repository...': Starting wildcard download[/*]
[*]'Found X files, excluded Y, starting update check...': File list retrieved[/*]
[*]'[Update] path (SHA: old... -> new...)': File updated[/*]
[*]'[New] path': New file downloaded[/*]
[*]'[Error] path: message': Download failed[/*]
[*]'Batch update complete: X updated, Y skipped, Z failed': Wildcard summary[/*]
[*]'Cache analysis: SHA matches cache (hash...), skipping download.': No changes detected[/*]
[*]'Cache analysis: SHA has changed': File changed, downloading[/*]
[*]'Cache analysis: No cache record, downloading for the first time': First download[/*]
[*]'Localization file updated: path, please restart the game!': Update complete[/*]
[*]'Files updated, please restart the game to apply changes!': Multiple files updated[/*]
[/list][line]
[size=4]FAQ[/size]

[b]Q: Where are downloaded files saved?[/b]
A: Files are saved to [font=Monaco,Consolas,'Lucida Console','Courier New',serif]CasualtiesUnknown_Data/Lang[/font] with their original filename.

[b]Q: How do I clear the cache?[/b]
A: Delete [font=Monaco,Consolas,'Lucida Console','Courier New',serif]BepInEx/cache/org.cncumc.i18nautoupdater.json[/font]. The plugin will re-download all files on the next check.

[b]Q: Can I use this with private repositories?[/b]
A: No, this plugin only supports public repositories via the GitHub API.

[b]Q: What happens if GitHub API is rate-limited?[/b]
A: The plugin will log an error and retry at the next scheduled check interval.

[line]

LGPL v3

Name: NeurotraumaModik
Description:
[center][b][size=5]NeurotraumaModik[/size][/b][/center]
[center][i][i]Barotrauma Neurotrauma-style medical realism for Casualties Unknown[/i][/i][/center]

[center][b]Version[/b] 2.3.2 · [b]Author[/b] Staili · [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/440]Nexus[/url][/center]

[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
A BepInEx plugin — adaptation of [b]Neurotrauma[/b] (Barotrauma) for [b]Casualties Unknown[/b], built on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/341][b]CUCoreLib[/b][/url].
[b]Multiplayer sync is optional[/b]: with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/67][b]Casualties Together (KrokMP)[/b][/url] afflictions sync in lobby; [b]without KrokMP the mod runs fully in single-player[/b].

One DLL (icons embedded) + a small [b]Content\Sound[/b] folder — no game file edits. Drop into [b]BepInEx\plugins\[/b].

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Afflictions[/b] — complications with icons and localized cure hints, tied to vanilla vitals (infection, cold, chest trauma, radiation, mood, alcohol, etc.). Includes fever ([b]fever[/b]), seizures ([b]seizure[/b] — aim penalty; rare control glitches above 30%), staged liver icons ([b]pechen_warning[/b] → [b]pechen_warning2[/b] → [b]pechen_dead[/b]), kidney/lung tiers, UNI-HEALTH chip faults, parasites, cuts/sutures, and more.[/*]
[*][b]Wound-view UI[/b] — per-limb icons on the body schematic; docked panel shows severity, category, treatments, and your blood type.[/*]
[*][b]Vanilla moodle bar[/b] — active mod afflictions in the bottom status strip (toggle: [b]ShowModMoodles[/b]).[/*]
[*][b]Surgery[/b] — not one-click: scalpel incision ([b]porez1[/b]) → retractor widen ([b]porez3[/b]) → internals; scissors extract foreign bodies; close with vanilla [b]medicalsuture[/b]. Tools: [b]nt_scalpel[/b], [b]nt_bonesaw[/b], [b]nt_retractor[/b], [b]nt_scissors[/b]. Transplants use one vanilla [b]internalorgans[/b] (≥40%) per organ (heart / lungs / kidneys / liver). Anesthesia via O2 condenser + serum.[/*]
[*][b]Parasites[/b] — after ~6 minutes of untreated [b]porez4/5_foreign[/b], random 1–5 parasites burrow ([b]parazite[/b] moodle at 100%). Extract with hands or vanilla tweezers (minigame). In MP (with KrokMP) peers can pull together. [b]nt_antiparasite[/b] is a [b]3-dose[/b] prophylaxis vial (~6 min) — does [b]not[/b] remove already burrowed parasites. Toggle: [b]EnableParasites[/b].[/*]
[*][b]Blood type (ABO+Rh)[/b] — random at spawn; shown on the panel and yellow blood-bag tooltips; persists across layers / [b]save.sv[/b]. Wrong typed transfusion → ~3 min high BP (~160) and HR 120. Craft: [b]bloodbag[/b] + 20 mL [b]alienblood[/b].[/*]
[*][b]Per-limb[/b] wounds / frostbite / chronic pain / parasites — tracked per extremity; synced in MP when KrokMP is present.[/*]
[*][b]Phantom effects[/b] — client-side spiders, vignette, whispers; psychosis >30 auditory flashbacks ([b]HallucinationVisuals[/b]).[/*]
[*][b]Multiplayer (optional)[/b] — with KrokMP: host-authoritative state, host symptom mask, heal allies in UNI-HEALTH, shared parasite minigame. Players without this mod may still join the lobby.[/*]
[*][b]Save persistence[/b] — mod status, blood type, parasite counts, and foreign-wound age in a [b]neurotrauma[/b] block inside [b]save.sv[/b].[/*]
[*][b]Crafting & loot[/b] — Medicine recipes; loot toggle [b]AddToLootPool[/b].[/*]
[*][b]Prosthetics compat[/b] — optional [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/40]Herobrine's Prosthetics[/url]: prosthetic limbs skip per-limb necrosis/tetanus/frostbite/chronic pain.[/*]
[*][b]Debug console[/b] — [b]nt_list[/b], [b]nt_add[/b], [b]nt_set[/b], [b]nt_clear[/b], [b]nt_diag[/b], [b]nt_limbs[/b], [b]nt_bloodtype[/b] (+ autofill; names with spaces OK). MP needs [b]sv_cheats[/b].[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Items[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]nt_scalpel[/b] — surgery: incision, necrosis debridement[/*]
[*][b]nt_bonesaw[/b] — amputation & organ transplant[/*]
[*][b]nt_retractor[/b] — widen wound, pleural drain, internals[/*]
[*][b]nt_scissors[/b] — foreign-body extract; eject condenser serum[/*]
[*][b]nt_antiparasite[/b] — 3 doses; prophylaxis (~6 min); mild liver/sepsis help — does not extract burrowed parasites[/*]
[*][b]nt_serum_sleep[/b] — anesthetic charge for the condenser[/*]
[*][b]nt_o2_condenser[/b] — empty = O₂ / clear hyperventilation; with serum = anesthesia[/*]
[*][b]nt_important_chip[/b] — replace a failing UNI-HEALTH board (craft: circuit board ≥90% + string×2)[/*]
[*][b]nt_bloodtype_op[/b] … [b]nt_bloodtype_abm[/b] — typed yellow blood packs[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx/releases/download/v5.4.23.5/BepInEx_win_x64_5.4.23.5.zip]BepInEx 5.4.23.5 (win_x64)[/url] — extract next to [b]CasualtiesUnknown.exe[/b][/*]

[size=4][b]Settings[/b][/size]
[b]Neurotrauma[/b] tab (with QoL.Unknown) or hotkey [b]F9[/b].

Description:

[color=#D4D4D8][i]A custom map loader for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4576490/]Casualties Unknown[/url], built on top of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/9]Custom Structures[/url], [url=https://github.com/CNCUMC/Bark]Bark[/url] and [url=https://github.com/jimmyking9999999/CUCoreLib]CUCoreLib[/url].[/i][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][i][b][i]Этой мод поддерживает русский язык (спасибо @Crescia1949 и [url=https://mimo.mi.com/]Mimo[/url] AI!)[/i][/b][/i][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
[b][i]This mod supports Russian (thanks to @Crescia1949 and [url=https://mimo.mi.com/]Mimo[/url] AI!)[/i][/b][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][b][i][i]@Crescia1949 не является носителем русского языка, и перевод с помощью ИИ может быть неточным. Пожалуйста, сообщайте о любых проблемах на [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/436]NexusMods[/url] или в [url=https://github.com/CNCUMC/Custom-Map/issues]GitHub Issues[/url].[/i][/i][/b][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
[i]@Crescia1949 is not a native Russian speaker, and AI translation may not be perfectly accurate. Please report any issues on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/436]NexusMods post[/url] or [url=https://github.com/CNCUMC/Custom-Map/issues]GitHub Issues[/url].[/i][/color]

[heading][color=#D4D4D8][i]Overview[/i][/color][/heading]
[color=#D4D4D8][i][b]Custom Map[/b] allows you to load custom-designed maps in Casualties Unknown.
[/i][/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][i][b]Layer-based maps[/b] — Multi-layer support with independent settings, structures, and commands per layer[/i][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][i][b]Feature system[/b] — Per-map configuration for mines, turrets, jump pads, spike stabbers, geysers, bear traps, and more[/i][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][i][b]Custom loading screen[/b] — Shows real-time progress during map generation[/i][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][i][b]Command interface[/b] — Full 
[/i][/color]
[code]cm[/code][color=#D4D4D8][i] command set for managing maps in-game[/i][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][i][b]Multi-language support[/b] — English, 简体中文, 繁體中文, Русский[/i][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][i][b]Built on Custom Structures[/b] — Extends [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/9]Custom Structures[/url] with multi-layer support, feature system, and in-game commands[/i][/color][/*]
[/list]
[heading][color=#D4D4D8][i]Installation[/i][/color][/heading]
[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][i]Install [url=https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx]BepInEx 5.x[/url] for Casualties Unknown.[/i][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][i]Install [url=https://github.com/jimmyking9999999/CUCoreLib]CUCoreLib[/url] — place 
[/i][/color]
[code]CUCoreLib.dll[/code][color=#D4D4D8][i] in 
[/i][/color]
[code]BepInEx/plugins/[/code][color=#D4D4D8][i].[/i][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][i]Install [url=https://github.com/CNCUMC/Bark]Bark[/url] — place 
[/i][/color]
[code]Bark.dll[/code][color=#D4D4D8][i] in 
[/i][/color]
[code]BepInEx/plugins/Bark/[/code][color=#D4D4D8][i].[/i][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][i]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/9]Custom Structures[/url] — place in 
[/i][/color]
[code]BepInEx/plugins/[/code][color=#D4D4D8][i].[/i][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][i]Install Custom Map, place in 
[/i][/color]
[code]BepInEx/plugins/Custom Map[/code][color=#D4D4D8][i].[/i][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][i]Place map folders in 
[/i][/color]
[code]Maps/[/code][color=#D4D4D8][i] (next to the game executable).[/i][/color][/*]
[/list]
[heading][color=#D4D4D8][i]Quick Start[/i][/color][/heading]
[color=#D4D4D8][i]Loading the Built-in Template
Custom Map includes a built-in template map. Enable [b]Start Game Use Map[/b] in mod settings, select the template, then start a new game.
Using Custom Maps
[/i][/color]
[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][i]Create a map folder under 
[/i][/color]
[code]Maps/your-map-name/[/code][color=#D4D4D8][i] (see [url=http://localhost:63342/markdownPreview/126697987/markdown-preview-index-b6c36iisgbq3gvm7mgjl5dop90.html#map-structure]Map Structure[/url]).[/i][/color][/*]

[/i][/color]
[code]Mod Settings → Custom Map → First Use Map[/code][color=#D4D4D8][i] dropdown.[/i][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][i]Type 
[/i][/color]
[code]cm select your-map-name[/code][color=#D4D4D8][i] in console, or select from the dropdown before starting.[/i][/color][/*]
[/list]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=6][i]For complete documentation, please view [url=https://github.com/CNCUMC/Custom-Map/blob/master/README.md]README.md on GitHub[/url].[/i][/size][/color]

Name: MultyModik
Description:
[center][b]MultyModik[/b]
[size=2][i]Multiplayer gameplay expansion for Casualties Unknown[/i][/size][/center]
[line]

[b]Description[/b]
[size=2]A BepInEx plugin by [b]Staili[/b] — add-on for [b]KrokoshaCasualtiesMP (KrokMP)[/b] in [b]Casualties Unknown[/b]. One DLL, no game file edits, drop into [i]BepInEx\plugins\[/i].

Extends the KrokMP run-rules menu with team respawns, mob scaling, a spider mini-boss, hugs, extra weapons per layer, sleep mood bonus, and more. Host configures everything in the lobby rules — settings sync to all clients.[/size]
[line]

[b]Main features[/b]
[list]
[*][size=2][b]Team respawns[/b] — shared team pool (configurable). Spectator self-respawn near a living ally (cooldown). Code-based ally revive: dead player gets a code, any living player can type it to bring them back. Honors [i]keep inventory[/i] / [i]keep stats[/i] rules.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Mob scaling[/b] — hostile spawn multiplier 100% (vanilla) up to 1000%. Floor scales with respawn limit (4+ → 200%, 40+ → 600%, 50 → 1000%). Separate [i]mission time[/i] slider (1–300%) with spawn penalties.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Water physics[/b] — [i]no water knockdown[/i] option. Trade-off: +100% to minimum hostile spawn while enabled.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Big Spider boss[/b] — checkbox in rules menu. Spawns on layer 2 at ~60% depth. 1000 HP, aggressive AI, chews through blocks, horrified effect, +40 team mood on kill. Console: [i]bigspider spawn[/i], [i]bigspider spawn force[/i], [i]bigspider spawn cursor[/i], [i]bigspider pos[/i].[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Hugs[/b] — button below CPR in the wound view. Hugger loses nothing; huggee +1 mood every 4 s. Visual [i]+1[/i] floats and chat barks. Uses KrokMP piggyback attach when allowed.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Extra weapons[/b] — per-layer tabs [i]1..6[/i] + 5 sliders (sound cannon, sand turret, electric coil, gun mine, mine). 0% = vanilla untouched, 100% = natural density, up to 1000%. Placed after worldgen, synced via rules preset.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Sleep mood[/b] — 2+ players sleeping within ~6 blocks slowly gain mood. Fully server-side, automatic.[/size][/*]
[/list]
[line]

[b]Installation[/b]
[list=1]
[*][size=2]Install [url=https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx/releases]BepInEx 5.4.x[/url] — [i]winhttp.dll[/i] next to [i]CasualtiesUnknown.exe[/i][/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/67]Casualties Together (KrokMP)[/url][/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Install CUCoreLib and [url=https://github.com/jimmyking9999999/QoL-Unknown/releases]QoL.Unknown[/url] → [i]BepInEx\plugins\[/i][/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Copy [i]MultyModikByStaili.dll[/i] to [i]BepInEx\plugins\[/i][/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Create or join a multiplayer session — new options appear in the **run-rules menu**[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]All players in the lobby must run the same plugin + KrokMP version[/size][/*]
[/list]
[line]

[b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*][size=2][b]Required mods (Nexus):[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/67][b]Casualties Together (KrokMP)[/b][/url] — multiplayer, run-rules menu, sync[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]CUCoreLib— [i]CUCoreLib.dll[/i] in [i]BepInEx\plugins\[/i][/size][/*]
[*][size=2][url=https://github.com/jimmyking9999999/QoL-Unknown/releases]QoL.Unknown[/url] — [i]QoL Unknown.dll[/i] in [i]BepInEx\plugins\[/i] (GitHub; Mods tab + **GIT** button)[/size][/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Required (non-mod):[/b] Casualties Unknown + BepInEx 5.4.x (Windows x64)[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Required (non-mod):[/b] Active multiplayer session (host + clients)[/size][/*]
[/list]
[line]

[b]Notes[/b]
[list]
[*][size=2]Settings are in the KrokMP **run-rules menu** before starting a run[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]May conflict with other mods patching [i]SpiderHandler[/i], mob spawn, or the wound-view UI[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Used by ModikStreamer for the [i]big_spider_boss[/i] donation event (optional)[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Optional: [url=https://github.com/jimmyking9999999/QoL-Unknown/releases]QoL.Unknown[/url] [/size][/*]
[/list]
[line]

Name: ModikDialog
Description:
[center][b]ModikDialog[/b]
[size=2][i]LLM trader dialogues for Casualties Unknown[/i][/size][/center]
[line]

[b]Description[/b]
[size=2]A BepInEx plugin by [b]Staili[/b] for [b]Casualties Unknown[/b] single-player trader dialogue. Right-click any trader — get a custom menu instead of instant barter.

Talk to traders with a local AI model: replies use your reputation, their stock, what you're holding, and your current state. No cloud API, no API key — everything runs on your PC via [i]llama-server[/i] (llama.cpp) + [i]Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct[/i] GGUF (~2 GB, manual download).[/size]
[line]

[b]Main features[/b]
[list]
[*][size=2][b]Trader menu[/b] — right-click a trader: [i]Talk / Trade / Leave[/i] (RU: [i]Общаться / Торговать / Уйти[/i]). [b]Trade[/b] opens the vanilla barter window.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]LLM dialogue[/b] — [b]Talk[/b] starts a conversation: greeting, speech bubbles, clickable question buttons. Each answer is generated locally.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Game context[/b] — the model sees trader reputation, inventory, item in hand, and player state for relevant replies.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Languages[/b] — RU / EN auto-detected from game locale (no manual language setting).[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Performance[/b] — profiles [i]Fast[/i] / [i]Balanced[/i] / [i]Quality[/i] in [i]settings.conf[/i]. CPU-only, no GPU required (AVX2, 4+ cores recommended).[/size][/*]
[/list][line]

[b]Installation[/b]
[list=1]
[*][size=2]Install [url=https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx/releases]BepInEx 5.4.x[/url] — [i]winhttp.dll[/i] next to [i]CasualtiesUnknown.exe[/i][/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Install CUCoreLib and [url=https://github.com/jimmyking9999999/QoL-Unknown/releases]QoL.Unknown[/url] → [i]BepInEx\plugins\[/i][/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Create [i]BepInEx\plugins\ModikDialog\[/i] and copy [i]ModikDialog.dll[/i] there[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Download [url=https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/releases]llama.cpp[/url] ([i]llama-*-bin-win-cpu-x64.zip[/i]) — extract into [i]BepInEx\plugins\ModikDialog\models\llama\[/i] ([i]llama-server.exe[/i] + DLLs)[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Download [url=https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct-GGUF]Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct Q4_K_M[/url] (~2 GB) → [i]BepInEx\plugins\ModikDialog\models\qwen2.5-3b-instruct-q4_k_m.gguf[/i][/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Right-click a trader in-game — the custom menu appears on the left[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Settings: [i]BepInEx\plugins\ModikDialog\models\settings.conf[/i] (fallback: [i]BepInEx\config\ModikDialogByStaili.cfg[/i])[/size][/*]
[/list](mirror download - https://github.com/naduvaha/ModikDialog/releases)
[line]

[b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*][size=2][b]Required mods (Nexus):[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]CUCoreLib — [i]CUCoreLib.dll[/i] in [i]BepInEx\plugins\[/i][/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b][url=https://github.com/jimmyking9999999/QoL-Unknown/releases]QoL.Unknown[/url] [/b]— [i]QoL Unknown.dll[/i] in [i]BepInEx\plugins\[/i][/size][/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Required (non-mod):[/b] Casualties Unknown Demo + BepInEx 5.4.x (Windows x64)[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Required (non-mod):[/b] [url=https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/releases]llama-server[/url] + [url=https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct-GGUF]Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct GGUF[/url] (~2 GB) — manual download, mod does not fetch files[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Required (non-mod):[/b] CPU 4+ cores (AVX2), ~2.5 GB free disk[/size][/*]
[/list]
[line]

[b]Notes[/b]
[list]
[*][size=2]First reply may take a few seconds while [i]llama-server[/i] loads the model[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]If slow: set [i]Profile = Fast[/i] in [i]settings.conf[/i], or use [url=https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct-GGUF]Qwen2.5-1.5B[/url] (lighter model)[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Check [i]BepInEx\LogOutput.log[/i] if [i]llama-server.exe[/i] or the GGUF file is not found[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Optional: [/size][b][url=https://github.com/jimmyking9999999/QoL-Unknown/releases]QoL.Unknown[/url][/b][/*]
[/list]
[line]

[*][size=2][b]TON / USDT:[/b] UQCI4s0ImjWashSanglRuIJuCIsjlJfSPedVR1YSUa45q4yS[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Telegram:[/b] [url=https://t.me/Stailick]@Stailick[/url][/size][/*]

[line]

[b]Description[/b]
[size=2]A BepInEx plugin by [b]Staili[/b] for [b]Casualties Unknown[/b] multiplayer chat. One DLL — no game file edits, drop into [i]BepInEx\plugins\[/i].

Type in your language — others read theirs. Incoming messages are translated for you with the original kept in [i][brackets][/i]. Free translation APIs, no API key.[/size]
[line]

[b]Main features[/b]
[list]
[*][size=2][b]Outgoing[/b] — your messages are sent in the language you pick (default EN). Change via the [b]right[/b] dropdown above chat (EN, ES, DE, ZH, and 20+ more).[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Incoming[/b] — foreign messages are translated into your language (default RU). Original text stays in [i][brackets][/i]. Change via the [b]left[/b] dropdown above chat.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Toggle[/b] — [i]Авто-перевод: ВКЛ / ВЫКЛ[/i] button above chat. Chat commands [i]/…[/i] are never translated.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Providers[/b] — MyMemory + Google fallback. Daily rate limits apply; switches provider automatically when one is exhausted.[/size][/*]
[/list]
[line]

[b]Installation[/b]
[list=1]
[*][size=2]Install [url=https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx/releases]BepInEx 5.4.x[/url] — [i]winhttp.dll[/i] next to [i]CasualtiesUnknown.exe[/i][/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/67]Casualties Together (KrokMP)[/url][/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Install CUCoreLib and [url=https://github.com/jimmyking9999999/QoL-Unknown/releases]QoL.Unknown[/url] → [i]BepInEx\plugins\[/i][/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Copy [i]ModikTranslate.dll[/i] to [i]BepInEx\plugins\[/i][/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Join a multiplayer session — three controls appear above the chat panel[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Config is created in [i]BepInEx\config\ModikTranslateByStaili.cfg[/i] on first launch[/size][/*]
[/list]
[line]

[b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*][size=2][b]Required mods (Nexus):[/b][/size]

[list]

Name: CasualtiesUnknown-Tarkov-Style Weapon Mod
Description:
Casualties: Unknown - Tarkov-Style Weapon Mod
Version: 1.0.3.0
A BepInEx mod for Casualties: Unknown Demo that brings Escape from Tarkov-inspired weapons into the game - 13 custom firearms, 2 melee weapons, 9 ammo types, and 9 magazines with a fully integrated caliber isolation system, weighted world spawns, melee weapon drops, and KrokMP multiplayer compatibility.
> **Requires:** CUTarkovMedicalMod and CUCoreLib must be installed first. This mod has a hard dependency on both.
---
REQUIREMENTS
- Game: Casualties: Unknown Demo (Steam)
- Mod Loader: BepInEx 5.x
- Required Mods: CUCoreLib + CUTarkovMedicalMod (install in this order)
Installing BepInEx:
1. Download BepInEx 5.x stable (x64) from https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx/releases
2. Extract into your game root folder (Steam/steamapps/common/Casualties Unknown Demo/)
3. Launch the game once to generate the BepInEx/ folder, then close it
---
INSTALLATION
1. Install CUCoreLib first
2. Install CUTarkovMedicalMod
3. Download CUTarkovWeaponMod_v1.0.3.0.zip
4. Extract the contents into your game root folder
  - After extraction:
    [Game Root]/BepInEx/plugins/CUTarkovWeaponMod/
      - CUTarkovWeaponMod.dll
      - Framework/Assets/  (weapon icons + gun sound effects)
      - Lang/              (EN.json, zh_CN.json)
5. Launch the game
Verify: check BepInEx/LogOutput.log for "Casualties: Unknown - Tarkov-Style Weapon Mod loaded."
---
WHAT'S NEW IN v1.0.3
- CUCoreLib hard dependency: migrated from soft dependency to hard dependency, removed Legacy mode and factory pattern
- KrokMP multiplayer compatibility:
  - World generation (supply crates/corpses/airdrops) only runs on host, clients receive items via KrokMP sync
  - Ammo/magazine unloading changed to world drop (FreshItemDrop) in multiplayer to prevent items going to host inventory
  - Synced weapons/mags/ammo display correct custom sprites (template pre-creation calls ConfigureCustomItem)
  - Inventory thumbnails show correct magazine/no-magazine state
- Console autocomplete fix: Command.argAutofill type corrected to Dictionary<int, List<string>>
- Melee weapon qualities:
  - Red Rebel ice axe: cutting 12 / hammering 18 / backflip / cangetwet / tool
  - M-2 tactical sword: cutting 30 / hammering 12 / backflip / cangetwet / tool
  - Hover description fix: no longer overwrites native detail page
- Magazine adjustments: all magazine values set to 2; UMP45 magazine icon resolution fixed (48x120 -> 13x32)
---
FEATURES
- 13 custom firearms: bolt-action snipers, semi-auto carbines, full-auto rifles, pump/semi-auto shotguns, pistols, SMG, PDW, LMG
- 2 melee weapons: Red Rebel ice axe (climbing + cutting + hammering) and M-2 tactical sword (cutting + hammering), with backflip tag for vertical back display
- 9 custom ammo types with dedicated calibers
- 9 custom magazines with correct capacity and crafting recipes
- Caliber isolation system: three-layer Harmony patches prevent cross-caliber loading
- Weighted world spawns: 35% pistol / 20% SKS+shotgun / 17% SMG / 13% rifle / 10% sniper / 5% LMG
- Melee weapon drops: 13% chance in supply crates (40% ice axe / 60% M-2 sword)
- Container drops: supply crates (6.6% gun + 10% mag), corpses (3% gun + 3% mag), airdrops (3% gun)
- Gun sound effects: unique fire/bolt/close/mag-in/mag-out sounds per weapon
- Preloaded melee swing sounds for instant playback without I/O lag
- Crafting system: magazines and ammo craftable via recipes
- Vanilla weapon replacement: original weapons/ammo/magazines blocked
- AXMC scope zoom: extended field of view when equipped
- UMP45 built-in suppressor: noise 0.2, muzzle flash disabled
- Console spawn support for all custom items
- Auto-update checker with download, progress bar, and one-click update
- Bilingual: English and Simplified Chinese
- KrokMP multiplayer compatible: host-only world generation, world drop for unloaded items, proper sprite sync
---
13 FIREARMS
1. AXMC (axmc) - Bolt-action sniper | .338 LM | 10-round mag | 310 bio dmg | Scope zoom
2. DVL-10 (dvl10) - Bolt-action sniper | 7.62x51 | 10-round mag | 205 bio dmg
3. SKS (sks) - Semi-auto carbine | 7.62x39 | 10-round internal | 150 bio dmg
4. AKM (akm) - Full-auto rifle | 7.62x39 | 30-round mag | 120 bio dmg
5. Desert Eagle (deagle) - Semi-auto pistol | .50 AE | 7-round mag | 110 bio dmg
6. M4A1 (m4a1) - Full-auto rifle | 5.56x45 | 30-round mag | 90 bio dmg
7. RPD (rpd) - Full-auto LMG | 7.62x39 | 100-round belt | 87 bio dmg
8. Glock 17 (glock17) - Semi-auto pistol | 9x19 | 17-round mag | 50 bio dmg
9. P90 (p90) - Full-auto PDW | 5.7x28 | 50-round mag | 45 bio dmg
10. UMP45 (ump45) - Full-auto SMG | .45 ACP | 25-round mag | 44 bio dmg | Built-in suppressor
11. MP-153 (mp153) - Semi-auto shotgun | 12 gauge | 8-round internal | 41 bio dmg | 8 pellets
12. MP-133 (mp133) - Pump shotgun | 12 gauge | 4-round internal | 40 bio dmg | 8 pellets
13. HK USP (usp) - Semi-auto pistol | .45 ACP | 12-round mag | 40 bio dmg
---
2 MELEE WEAPONS
1. Red Rebel Ice Axe (redrebel) - 37 bio dmg / 35 block dmg | Range 4 | Knockback 270 | INT 5 | Cutting 12 | Hammering 18 | Special: wall-climb when held in main hand, backflip
2. M-2 Tactical Sword (m2sword) - 87 bio dmg / 31 block dmg | Range 7 | Knockback 320 | INT 5 | Cutting 30 | Hammering 12 | backflip
---
9 AMMO TYPES
1. .338 LM UCW (338ucw) - For AXMC
2. 7.62x51 BPZ (76251bpz) - For DVL-10
3. 7.62x39 SP (76239sp) - For SKS / AKM / RPD
4. 12/70 8.5mm (12g85) - For MP-133 / MP-153
5. .50 AE Copper (50copper) - For Desert Eagle
6. .45 ACP FMJ (45fmj) - For UMP45 / USP
7. 9x19 PSO (919pso) - For Glock 17
8. 5.56x45 FMJ (55645fmj) - For M4A1
9. 5.7x28 SB193 (5728sb193) - For P90
---
9 MAGAZINES
1. AXMC Magazine (axmc_mag) - 10 rounds | Value 2
2. DVL-10 Magazine (dvl10_mag) - 10 rounds | Value 2
3. AKM Magazine (akm_mag) - 30 rounds | Value 2
4. Desert Eagle Magazine (deagle_mag) - 7 rounds | Value 2
5. Glock 17 Magazine (glock17_mag) - 17 rounds | Value 2
6. M4A1 Magazine (m4a1_mag) - 30 rounds | Value 2
7. P90 Magazine (p90_mag) - 50 rounds | Value 2
8. UMP45 Magazine (ump45_mag) - 25 rounds | Value 2
9. USP Magazine (usp_mag) - 12 rounds | Value 2
---
CALIBER ISOLATION SYSTEM
Three-layer Harmony patches ensure each firearm only accepts its designated ammo caliber:
- GunScript.LoadMag - magazine-to-gun caliber check
- AmmoScript.LoadRound - ammo-to-magazine caliber check
- AmmoScript.UnloadRound - prevents incorrect ammo unloading
Shared calibers:
- 7.62x39: SKS / AKM / RPD
- 12 gauge: MP-133 / MP-153
- .45 ACP: UMP45 / USP
---
CONSOLE SPAWN
All items spawnable via: spawn [itemkey]
Examples: spawn axmc, spawn akm, spawn 338ucw, spawn akm_mag, spawn redrebel, spawn m2sword, spawn usp
Toggle vanilla weapons: spawn vanilla_on / spawn vanilla_off
---
AUTO-UPDATE
The mod includes a built-in update checker:
- Automatically checks for new versions on startup
- Two update options: Auto Update (download + install + restart) or Release Page
- Download progress bar with speed indicator
- Cancel download at any time
- Auto-timeout on stalled downloads
- One-click restart after update
---
COMPATIBILITY
- Requires CUCoreLib + CUTarkovMedicalMod (hard dependency)
- KrokMP: compatible (host-only world generation, world drop for unloaded items, sprite sync)
- Other BepInEx mods: should be compatible (unique GUID, independent Harmony patches)
---
UNINSTALL
Delete BepInEx/plugins/CUTarkovWeaponMod/ folder.
---
SOURCE CODE
Open source on GitHub: https://github.com/hmm1313133/CUTarkovWeaponMod
---
BUG REPORTS & FEEDBACK
Report bugs and suggestions on GitHub Issues: https://github.com/hmm1313133/CUTarkovWeaponMod/issues
Please include:
1. Mod version (1.0.3.0)
2. Game version
3. BepInEx version
4. Other installed mods
5. Steps to reproduce
6. Log file (BepInEx/LogOutput.log)
7. Screenshots if applicable
Please check existing issues before posting to avoid duplicates.
---
CREDITS
- Escape from Tarkov by Battlestate Games - original weapon designs and mechanics inspiration
- Casualties: Unknown - the base game
- BepInEx - modding framework
- Harmony - runtime patching library
- CUCoreLib - custom item infrastructure
---
This mod is not affiliated with or endorsed by Battlestate Games or the developers of Casualties: Unknown. All trademarks belong to their respective owners.

[[url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1xt0kDIFGH3biCaG6MPU3tneUJ28mXYmNQjmIXA41DlE/edit?usp=sharing][/url][url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1xt0kDIFGH3biCaG6MPU3tneUJ28mXYmNQjmIXA41DlE/edit?usp=sharing]Click Here to Learn About Custom Character Sprites[/url]]

[*]Multiple New Moodles[/*]
[*]Custom Expie Skin Support[/*]
[*]Multiple New Trader Interactions[/*]
[*]New Dialogue[/*]
[*]Translation Support [/*]

[*]Supports [b]NPC Mods[/b] like AxivornsExpieNPCMod (Drag their Head to Consume)[/*]
[*]Supports [b]Normal + QoL:Unknown Save Files[/b][/*]
[*]Supports [b]CasualtiesXL[/b] Fully (Custom Sprites for each Weight Stage Coming Soon thanks to NemoTheAxolotl)[/*]
[/list][spoiler][b]Vorny Mode:[/b]
[list]
[*]Expies no longer experience pain when swallowing creatures. Stomach health still depletes.[/*]
[*]Swallowing creatures over time will make Expies happier.[/*]
[*]Going for long periods without swallowing creatures causes depression depending on withdrawal tolerance.[/*]
[*]Additional growl sounds to when the Expie is hungry.[/*]
[*]Special Dialogue.[/*]
[*]Some Traders can find Vore appealing, and will not struggle.[/*]

[/list]This Mod is heavily inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/178]Casualties XL[/url]. It originally started as Custom Character preset for that.

This Mod's Multiplayer Sprite Networking is based on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/118]ChangeSkin-Multiplayer[/url], but has been written independently to better fit this mod as well as include support for XL and Vore Sprites by using Fragmented Packets.

Name: CasualtiesUnknown TarkovMedicalMod
Description:
Version: 0.2.9
Author: hmm1313133
Mod GUID: com.yourname.cu.tarkovmedicalmod
GitHub: https://github.com/hmm1313133/CUTarkovMedicalMod
===========================================================
DESCRIPTION
===========================================================
A BepInEx mod for Casualties: Unknown Demo that brings 16 Tarkov-style combat stimulants, 12 medical items, and a complete medical system into the game.

Features:
- 16 custom stimulant injectors with unique effects and side effects (no temporary skill level boosts)
- 12 medical items (first aid kits, surgery kits, ointments, pills)
- Starting item grants + world loot spawning
- Intelligence-based Recognition system (hide names/effects when INT too low)
- Buff indicator via native MoodleManager
- Tunnel vision URP Vignette post-processing
- Multi-language support (EN/zh_CN)
- CUCoreLib hard dependency (non-destructive save coordination)
- Medical effect serialization system (Eff.Ser/Res) — saves/restores all active stimulant effects across floors
- KrokMP multiplayer full support:
  - Per-player effect controllers run independently on each client
  - Health sync interception prevents host from overriding client stimulant effects
  - Client inventory save/restore on reconnect (items + medical effects)
  - Buff indicator correctly shows only local player's effects
- Console spawn support for all custom items
- Hover description (SHIFT to expand effect details)

Stimulant Overview (v0.2.9 balance changes):
- SJ1: Changed from STR+5/RES+3 → stamina cap +10%, stamina recovery +50% (+ mild opiate)
- SJ12: Removed temporary RES+2 toughness boost
- PNB: Removed temporary RES+3 resilience boost (keeps nail repair + muscle healing + permanent STR-1 penalty)
- Obdolbos2 permanent skill boosts remain unchanged
- All temporary skill level increases removed — only permanent changes remain (Propital/SJ9 penalties, Obdolbos/Obdolbos2 permanent boosts)

===========================================================
REQUIREMENTS
===========================================================
- BepInEx 5.x
- Casualties: Unknown Demo
- CUCoreLib (required — hard dependency for save coordination and item registration)
- Optional: QoL Unknown (save compatibility handled automatically via CUCoreLib)
- Optional: KrokMP (multiplayer safe mode auto-detected)

===========================================================
INSTALLATION
===========================================================
1. Download CUTarkovMedicalMod_v0.2.9.zip
2. Extract the contents directly into BepInEx/plugins/CUTarkovMedicalMod/
  (DLL, Framework/, and Lang/ should be at the top level)
3. Ensure CUCoreLib.dll is in BepInEx/plugins/
4. Launch the game

===========================================================
CHANGELOG
===========================================================
v0.2.9 - 2026-07-16
- Balance: Removed all temporary skill level increases from stimulants
  - SJ1: STR+5/RES+3 replaced with stamina cap +10% + stamina recovery +50% (+ mild opiate)
  - SJ12: RES+2 temporary toughness boost removed
  - PNB: RES+3 temporary resilience boost removed
  - Permanent skill changes remain: Propital RES/STR -2, SJ9 RES -2, Obdolbos2 STR/RES/INT +6
- Refactor: CUCoreLib changed from soft dependency to hard dependency
  - Removed LegacyMode, IIntegrationMode interface; Integration layer simplified to CUCoreLibMode only
  - BepInDependency changed from SoftDependency to HardDependency
- Feature: Medical effect serialization system (Eff.Ser/Res)
  - Serializes/restores all active stimulant effect controllers across floor transitions
  - Handles side-effect timers and phase state (SJ9/Obdolbos2/Blueblood)
  - Registered as IBodySaveProvider via CUCoreLib SaveRegistry
- Feature: KrokMP multiplayer full support
  - KrokMpHelper: ShouldApplyUseEffect guard on all 18 injector useAction delegates
  - KrokMpHealthSyncPatch: Intercepts health sync packets to prevent host overriding client stimulant effects
  - KrokMpStateBridge: Reconnect effect restoration + inventory recovery for disconnected clients
  - KrokMpLiquidSyncPatch: Prevents container item sync from resetting custom liquid items
  - QolMpSaveCompat: Patches QoL save system for custom item creation + effect injection into snapshots
  - MultiPlayerStateSaveProvider: Saves/restores non-host player state (health, skills, position, inventory, effects)
  - StimBuffIndicator: Local-body filter prevents showing remote player buff indicators
- Fix: ETG/Zagustin debuff tick now uses direct field modification instead of body.Eat()/Drink()
  (avoids KrokMP network sync interception on those native methods)
- Fix: Eff.Ser() serialization check now includes debuff/side-effect remaining timers
- Fix: KrokMpHealthSyncPatch uses __0 indexed parameters instead of named params (matches KrokMP Apply method signatures)
- Removed: NexusMods_Description_Simple.txt and NexusMods_Weapon_Description_Simple.txt (consolidated into cu.txt)

v0.2.7 - 2026-07-14
- Fix: Injectors stored inside containers (medkit) reverted to base "syringe" when
  transitioning to the next floor
  - Root cause: QoLSaveFix Phase 2 only searched by custom ID, but container items
    still had base prefab ID ("syringe") after Prefix replacement. Phase 1 only
    converted items directly in body slots, not container children.
  - Fix: Phase 2 now falls back to searching by base prefab ID when custom ID search
    fails, then converts the found item back to custom. Uses HashSet to avoid
    duplicate matches when multiple injectors share the same base prefab.
- Fix: Custom injectors disappeared when held in main hand with CUCoreLib installed
  - Root cause: CUCoreLib ApplyCustomItemComponents recalculates condition as
    liquidAmount/capacity. With capacity=1 and no liquid contents, condition=0,
    causing the item to vanish even with destroyAtZeroCondition=false.
  - Fix: Set capacity=0 (skips condition recalculation) + defaultContents=[{water,0}]
    (triggers "waterbottle" template in ChooseTemplateId, avoiding "bandage" which
    caused IndexOutOfRangeException). condition stays at 1.0 as set by ConfigureSpawnedItem.
- Refactor: Centralized item definitions in MedicalItemDefinitions (shared by both modes)

v0.2.6 - 2026-07-13
- Fix: "Error occured during loading item 'propital(Clone) (Item)'" when both QoL Unknown
  and CUCoreLib are installed simultaneously
- Refactor: Integration layer cleanly separates CUCoreLib vs legacy behavior

v0.2.5 - 2026-07-13
- Fix: StimBuffIndicator IndexOutOfRangeException when backgroundIcons array is too short
- Integration: CUCoreLib compatibility layer + QoL Unknown save fix
- Feature: 12 medical items (Grizzly/AFAK/IFAK/Salewa/CMS/MultiTool/AI-2/GoldenStar/Vaseline/Libatine/Ibuprofen)
- Feature: StimBuffIndicator with native MoodleManager integration
- Feature: Tunnel vision URP Vignette overlay

v0.2.1
- Feature: Starting item grant system
- Feature: World loot spawning
- Feature: Intelligence-based Recognition system
- Feature: Multi-language I18n system

v0.2.0
- Feature: 16 combat stimulant injectors
- Feature: Custom useAction delegate system
- Feature: Effect controllers with buff/debuff phases

v0.1.0
- Initial release

===========================================================
BUG REPORTS
===========================================================
Please report bugs at: https://github.com/hmm1313133/CUTarkovMedicalMod/issues
Include your BepInEx/LogOutput.log file.

Name: Too Many Settings
Description:
[size=6][b]TooManySettings[/b][/size]

[quote][url=https://github.com/MelnCat/cu-toomanysettings]GitHub Repository[/url][/quote]
Adds more run settings to the game that may or may not be balanced.

Warning: Turning someone of the settings too high may result in lag,
although you should probably expect for turning something to 100x.

[size=6][b]Settings[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Minibarrel Multiplier[/b][/size]

The amount of minibarrels to spawn. Defaults to 1x.

Turn this higher if you want more minibarrels everywhere, or lower if you hate fun and gambling.

[size=4][b]Enemy Multiplier[/b][/size]

The amount of enemies to spawn. Defaults to 1x.

This can be useful if the base trap multiplier is increased, as you can use this setting to decrease enemies specifically while keeping nonliving traps still high.

[size=4][b]Geyser Multiplier[/b][/size]

The amount of geysers to spawn. Defaults to 1x.

Turn this up if you want to suffer.

[size=4][b]Plant Multiplier[/b][/size]

The amount of plants (like glowplants) to spawn. Defaults to 1x.

[size=4][b]Fluid Multiplier[/b][/size]

The relative size of naturally spawning fluid pools to spawn (like lakes and stuff). Defaults to 1x.

[size=4][b]Climbable Multiplier[/b][/size]

The amount of climbable rope/vine to spawn. Defaults to 1x.

[size=4][b]Spawn Extra Random Loot[/b][/size]

Whether to spawn random items around the world. Defaults to false.

This is NOT the random items spawned on corpses. This is a separate custom spawning mechanism.

[size=4][b]Extra Random Loot Multiplier[/b][/size]

The amount of random items to spawn for the Spawn Extra Random Loot setting. Defaults to 1x.

Does nothing if Spawn Extra Random Loot is off.

Name: More Amputation
Description:
[size=5][b]Requires BepInEx and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/341]CUCoreLib[/url]! [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/40]Prosthetics[/url] mod is also highly recommended![/b][/size]

This mod modifies various traps in the base game to give them a threat of amputation, so the Salad isn't the only time you need to worry about losing your arm.

- All explosions now have the [b]chance of disfigurement divided by 4[/b] to amputate any of your arm or leg limbs, up to a limit of 1 amputated limb per explosion.
- Spike traps now have a chance to [b]amputate broken hands and feet[/b].
- Bear traps have been [b]fully reworked[/b] -- they no longer let you go automatically, and [b]must be disarmed in a new minigame to free your limb from it[/b]. Be careful though -- [b]severe mistakes can break the limb's bones or, if already broken, amputate it altogether![/b]
- Alternatively, you can break the bear trap with your claws or a tool instead to free your limb, at the likely risk of [b]shrapnel damage, bleeding and pain.[/b]

[left]The mod is currently in balance testing due to the bear trap minigame -- if you believe that the minigame is too easy or too difficult, leave a comment![/left]
[left][/left]
[left]Currently supports English and Russian (Thanks to Nichs1k!), but the localization files are packaged with the mod files, so anyone can contribute![/left]
[left][/left]
[left]GitHub Repository: [url=https://github.com/IAmLeftie/CUMoreAmputation]https://github.com/IAmLeftie/CUMoreAmputation[/url][/left]

Name: UCU Mod Manager
Description:
[b][size=4]Description[/size] [/b]
The main goal of the project is to simplify working with mods so you do not have to manually rebuild the game every time you want to update mods, switch builds, or prepare a new modpack.

[b][size=4]Virtualization[/size][/b] is currently being actively tested. With this feature, the base game with BepInEx installed remains unchanged: mods are loaded through a profile overlay, and you can freely switch, edit, and create different configurations.

[color=#f1c232][b]UCU Mod Manager is currently in alpha. Please report bugs, launch errors,
Mod installation issues, virtualization problems, or any odd behavior in the manager.
[/b][/color]
[b][color=#f1c232][size=4]For now, virtualization should be treated as an alpha feature. It is [i]recommended by default[/i], but feedback and bug reports are very important.[/size][/color][/b]

[b][size=4]Important[/size][/b]
Use a clean game installation whenever possible. BepInEx must be installed into the game folder first, preferably through UCU Mod Manager itself.
The manager treats a clean game with BepInEx installed as the expected base state. Mods, profiles, modpacks, and manager data are stored inside the manager folder.

[b][size=4]Features[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Install mods from Nexus Mods catalog, archives or folders.[/*]
[*]Manage separate profiles with their own enabled mods and load order.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through an experimental virtual profile.[/*]
[*]Official Nexus Mods authentication using OAuth 2.0 with PKCE.[/*]
[*]Check for updates and install them automatically or via manual archive downloads.[/*]
[*]Create and import ` .UCU ` modpack recipes.[/*]
[*]Create and import `.UCUP` portable modpacks with included mod files.[/*]
[*]Show mod dependencies, warnings, conflicts, and Nexus information.[/*]
[/list]
[b][size=4]Installation[/size][/b]
1. Download the latest release archive.
2. Extract it into an empty folder.
3. Run `UCU Mod Manager.exe`.

[b][url=https://github.com/ArchBlake/UCUModManager]GitHub[/url][/b]
[b][url=https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file/8c04592e8abbac23cf7cb15f7db1653ef24e181d3fd8cdb58c2f75d36d5e8efd]VirusTotal[/url][/b]
Metadata from: [url=https://github.com/jimmyking9999999][b]Jimmyking[/b][/url]

[b][size=4]Requirements[/size][/b]
[list]
[*].NET 8 Desktop Runtime.[/*]
[*]Steam version of Casualties Unknown Demo.[/*]
[/list]

Name: RshCCL
Description:
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/8391/images/403/403-1783194836-1653366416.png[/img]
[url=https://github.com/CNCUMC/RshCCL/blob/main/README_ZH.md]中文指南[/url]

[quote][b]⚠️ RshCCL is a compatibility bridge only.[/b]

Developers should always prefer using [url=https://github.com/jimmyking9999999/CUCoreLib]CUCoreLib[/url] directly.

Players should ask mod authors to migrate to CUCoreLib as their API dependency.[/quote]
[url=https://github.com/CNCUMC/RshCCL]GitHub[/url] | [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/403]NexusMods[/url] | [url=https://github.com/jimmyking9999999/CUCoreLib]CUCoreLib[/url]

[i]A compatibility bridge that forwards legacy RshLib API calls to [url=https://github.com/jimmyking9999999/CUCoreLib]CUCoreLib[/url] (CCL).[/i]

[line]

[size=4][b]Overview[/b][/size]

[b]RshCCL[/b] is a drop-in replacement for RshLib [i](in most cases)[/i]. It keeps the [i]Plugin.RegisterItem(string, RshItem)[/i] API surface so older mods work unchanged, while internally routing all registrations through CUCoreLib.

[b]Key features:[/b]

[b]RegisterItem[/b] – Converts [i]RshItem[/i] → [i]CustomItemInfo[/i], then calls [i]ItemRegistry.Register[/i]

[b]onSpawn callback[/b] – Injected via CCL [i]SpawnComponents[/i] + [i]RshSpawnCallback[/i] MonoBehaviour

[b]krokMpEnabled / togetherMpEnabled[/b] – Provided as backwards‑compatible fields

[b]Conflict avoidance[/b] – Removes self from [i]Chainloader.PluginInfos[/i] so mods like NewClothing use their native CCL path

[b]Console autofill[/b] – Patches [i]spawn[/i] command to include every CCL‑registered item

[b]Recipe‑list crash guard[/b] – Harmony finalizer catches NRE in [i]RefreshRecipeList[/i]

[line]

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]

Install [url=https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx]BepInEx 5.x[/url] for Casualties Unknown.

Install [url=https://github.com/jimmyking9999999/CUCoreLib]CUCoreLib[/url] ≥ 1.0.1 — place [i]CUCoreLib.dll[/i] in [i]BepInEx/plugins/[/i].

Download the latest [i]RshCCL.dll[/i] from [url=https://github.com/CNCUMC/RshCCL/releases]Releases[/url].

Place [i]RshCCL.dll[/i] in [i]BepInEx/plugins/[/i].

[b]Remove[/b] the old [i]RshLib.dll[/i] if it exists.

[quote][b]⚠️ Important:[/b] RshCCL uses the same BepInEx GUID as old RshLib ([i]com.rushellxyz.rshlib[/i]).

Only [b]one[/b] [i]RshLib.dll[/i] should be present in your plugins folder.[/quote]
[line]

[size=4][b]Notes[/b][/size]

RshLib itself never provided path or resource‑loading APIs. Older mods that hard‑code paths like [i]"BepInEx/plugins/MyMod/image.png"[/i] must update their own resource‑loading code.

Consider migrating to CCL's [url=https://github.com/jimmyking9999999/CUCoreLib]AssetLoader[/url] which resolves paths relative to the calling DLL.
[quote]⚠️ Some compatibility issues are not caused by RshCCL and also occur with original RshLib.
For those, install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/424]CUModFixer[/url] as well.[/quote]
[line]

[size=4][b]Project Structure[/b][/size]
[code]
RshCCL/
├── Plugin.cs # Entry point: compatibility API + conflict avoidance
├── RshItem.cs # Legacy RshItem type (backwards compat)
├── RshItemAdapter.cs # RshItem → CustomItemInfo converter + onSpawn callback
├── Patches.cs # ConsoleScript, GlobalDark, RefreshRecipeList guard
├── RshLib.csproj # Project file (depends on CUCoreLib)
├── CHANGELOG.md # English changelog
├── CHANGELOG_ZH.md # Chinese changelog
├── README.md
└── README_ZH.md[/code]
Author: CNCUMC

Name: Massive Casualties
Description:
[center][size=2][img width=700]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/8391/images/400/400-1783307655-1303799286.png[/img][/size][/center]
[center][size=2]Note: this mod is [b]extremely WIP[/b], and bugs are expected. If you encounter any issues, please let me know![/size][/center]

[color=#3d85c6][size=4][b]Description[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]As you search the target planet, you'll find "Improvised Lifts" scattered throughout your world, allowing you to freely travel between sessions while keeping your character and world intact. Each lift is permanent bridge between two worlds, letting you explore not only your own cave, but the ones others are trapped in as well. Who will you meet along your journey?[/color]

[color=#3d85c6][size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]First, install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/67]Casualties Together[/url][/color][color=#ffffff] [/color]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/341]CUCoreLib[/url], then download this mod and unzip it inside your BepInEx/plugins directory. To play, start a multiplayer server through the multiplayer menu (make sure it says "Massive Casualties: Enabled"), or join a server with the mod installed. MassiveCasualties is fully compatible with the multiplayer mod, and can be enabled/disabled as needed.

Since this mod is very early in development, there probably won't be many sessions online. Stick with it, and that might soon change!

[color=#3d85c6][size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*]Multiplayer travel: let your character move between sessions while keeping all your items (and injuries) intact.[/*]
[*]Return to your own world as you left it: worlds are saved automatically when moving between sessions, and are automatically loaded when you go back to them.[/*]
[*]Automatic host switching: when the host of a lobby disconnects, someone else takes their place instead of the entire server going down and everyone losing progress.[/*]
[/list]Note: these features are only available in Massive Casualties-enabled lobbies, and are automatically disabled otherwise for compatibility.

[b][color=#3d85c6][size=4]Support[/size][/color]
[/b]The quickest way to contact me is through the [url=https://discord.gg/ehCptz9pwU]Casualties: Unknown Modding Discord[/url]. A lot of other mod authors hang out there, so it's a good place to get support for their mods as well.

If the lift isn't working, there's a few main reasons why:
[list=1]
[*]There aren't any other Massive Casualties-enabled lobbies online.[/*]
[*]The lobby the lift is linked to no longer exists.[/*]
[*]The world you're trying to go to is "owned" by someone else on the server, and they need to go through the lift first.[/*]
[/list]The easiest fix is to have other people try the lift, and to find a different lift to try.

Name: ShatteredPrism
Description:
[center][size=6][b]ShatteredPrism[/b][/size]
[size=3][i]A screen-space shader loader for Casualties Unknown[/i][/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][i]wiki:  [url=https://wiki.ethertaco.org/shatteredprism/]ShatteredPrism - Ethertaco Docs[/url][/i][/center]

[line]

[size=5][b]概述 / Overview[/b][/size]

[b]ShatteredPrism[/b] is a screen-space shader loader. It allows modders and pack authors to layer custom full-screen shader effects onto the game without writing a single line of C# code. By simply dropping in a JSON manifest and a pre-compiled AssetBundle.

[b]ShatteredPrism[/b] 是一个屏幕后处理（screen-space）着色器加载器。它允许模组制作者和效果包作者在不编写任何 C# 代码的情况下，将自定义全屏 Shader 叠加到游戏画面上。只需放入一个 JSON 清单文件和一个预编译的 AssetBundle。

[line]

[size=5][b]需求 / Requirements[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]BepInEx 5.4.x[/b][/*]
[*][b]ScavLib API (SLA)[/b] — This mod is built upon the ScavLib Shader API. / 本模组构建在 ScavLib API 的 Shader API 之上。[/*]
[/list][line]

[size=5][b]安装 / Installation[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Ensure BepInEx and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/83?tab=files]SLA[/url] are installed. / 确保已安装 BepInEx 与 SLA。[/*]
[*]Place [b]ShatteredPrism.dll[/b] into [font=Courier New]BepInEx/plugins/ShatteredPrism/[/font]. / 将 [b]ShatteredPrism.dll[/b] 放入插件目录。[/*]
[*]Create an [font=Courier New]effects/[/font] folder in the same directory. / 在同目录下建立 [font=Courier New]effects/[/font] 文件夹。[/*]
[*]Drop your [b].json manifests[/b] and [b]AssetBundles[/b] into the effects folder. / 将你的 [b].json 清单[/b]与 [b]AssetBundle[/b] 放入该文件夹。[/*]
[*]Launch the game and enter any level to see the results. / 启动游戏，进入任意关卡即可看到效果。[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]制作效果包 / Authoring an Effect[/b][/size]

Each effect consists of two files: a [b]JSON manifest[/b] describing parameters and an [b]AssetBundle[/b] containing your URP shader.
每个效果由两个文件组成：一个描述参数的 [b]JSON 清单[/b]，以及一个包含 URP Shader 的 [b]AssetBundle[/b]。

[size=4][b]1. Manifest Example / 清单示例 (effects/my_effect.json)[/b][/size]

[code]
{
  "id": "author:vignette",
  "shader": "MyMod/Vignette",
  "bundle": "my_effects",
  "order": 100,
  "enabled": true,
  "floats": [
    { "name": "_Intensity", "value": 0.9 }
  ],
  "colors": [
    { "name": "_Tint", "hex": "#0A0014FF" }
  ],
  "pulses": [
    { "name": "_Intensity", "amplitude": 0.1, "speed": 2.0, "offset": 0.9 }
  ]
}[/code]
[list]
[*][b]id[/b]: Unique identifier for the pass. / 效果的唯一标识。[/*]
[*][b]shader[/b]: The name declared in the shader file's [font=Courier New]Shader "..."[/font] header. / Shader 文件顶部声明的名字（[b]非文件名[/b]）。[/*]
[*][b]bundle[/b]: AssetBundle filename relative to the manifest. / AssetBundle 文件名（相对路径）。[/*]
[*][b]order[/b]: Rendering priority; lower values render first. / 渲染顺序；数值越小越先渲染。[/*]
[*][b]floats / colors / pulses[/b]: Uniforms passed to the shader. [i]Pulses[/i] are animated via sine waves. / 传给 Shader 的变量；[i]Pulses[/i] 会随时间进行正弦波动。[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]2. Shader Requirements / Shader 技术要求[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Must be a [b]URP[/b] shader compatible with [b]Unity 2022.3 / URP 14[/b]. / 必须是兼容 [b]Unity 2022.3 / URP 14[/b] 的 [b]URP[/b] 着色器。[/*]
[*]The source image is bound to [font=Courier New]_BlitTexture[/font]. Use [font=Courier New]SAMPLE_TEXTURE2D_X[/font] for sampling. / 源图像绑定在 [font=Courier New]_BlitTexture[/font]，请使用 [font=Courier New]SAMPLE_TEXTURE2D_X[/font] 采样。[/*]
[*]To prevent pink "fallback" shaders, add your shader to [i]Always Included Shaders[/i] before building the bundle. / 为防止变体剔除导致画面变粉，打包前请将 Shader 加入 [i]Always Included Shaders[/i]。[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]工作原理 / How It Works[/b][/size]

ShatteredPrism itself does not contain any shaders. It acts as a bridge between your assets and the ScavLib Shader API. It handles manifest parsing, asset loading, and pass registration, while ScavLib manages the heavy lifting: URP injection, uniform updates, and frame blitting.

ShatteredPrism 本身[b]不包含任何 Shader 和 API 实现[/b]。它充当了你的资源与 ScavLib Shader API 之间的桥梁，负责解析清单、加载资源与注册通道；而 ScavLib 则负责核心渲染工作：URP 注入、变量更新以及每帧的图像 Blit。

[line]
Author: QinShenYu and Kanisuko

Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]This is a small extension mod for  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/67]Casualties: Together[/url], adding simple control over your run settings that are then sent to other clients when the server starts. Works for both dedicated servers and regular servers.[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]GitHub [url=https://github.com/DarkDibblez/casualtiestogether-autoloadrunsettings]here[/url].[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Install [b]BepInEx[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Install [b]Casualties: Together (aka KrokMP)[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Install [b]AutoLoadRunSettings[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Update runsettings.txt with your own run settings (copy from in-game after tweaking your settings to your liking)[/color][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Whenever the host starts the run, the mod will attempt to load runsettings.txt and apply it to the game. The file is reloaded at the start of every run so feel free to replace the settings between runs if you wish.[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8][size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#d4d4d8][size=3]I have not made any efforts (yet) to improve compatibility with other mods. If it doesn't play nice with the base Cas:T mod, this will most likely not do so, either. Most functionality I leverage is present in the Cas:T mod so compatibility will be largely dependent on them.[/size][/color]

[color=#d4d4d8][size=4][b]Known incompatibilities[/b]: [/size][/color]
[color=#d4d4d8][size=4][b]QoL:[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#d4d4d8][size=3]Loading QoL saves will always overrule the settings from my mod. I believe this to be intentional as a mid-layer QoL save saves a LOT of information that can and will affect layer generation.[/size][/color]
[color=#d4d4d8][size=3]Not sure how QoL behaves when starting a new run.[/size][/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]

Name: Casualty Vitals
Description:
[size=5]Casualty Vitals[/size]

Casualty Vitals replaces the vanilla Casualties Unknown ECG panel with a richer patient monitor powered by a BepInEx 5 plugin. It adds multi-channel waveform viewing, progressive clinical-ish complications, alarm tinting, manual defibrillator support, and a few strange but medically flavored edge cases.

This is an experimental gameplay/immersion mod. It is not medical advice, a diagnosis tool, or a realistic clinical simulator.
"experimental" as in some complications (see Gameplay Effects below) may be broken, unbalanced or too small to show.

[size=4]Translations / 翻译 / Переводы / Traducciones[/size]

English: Casualty Vitals includes English, Simplified Chinese, Russian, and
Spanish text. `Auto` follows the game's language when it is one of those supported
locales. To choose one manually or create a translation, see
`BepInEx\plugins\Assets\CasualtyVitals\` and set `[Localization] Language` in
`BepInEx\config\CasualtyVitals.cfg`.

简体中文： Casualty Vitals 提供英语、简体中文、俄语和西班牙语文本。Auto
会在游戏语言受支持时自动使用对应语言。若要手动选择语言或制作翻译，请查看
BepInEx\plugins\Assets\CasualtyVitals\，并在
BepInEx\config\CasualtyVitals.cfg 中设置 [Localization] Language。

Русский: Casualty Vitals включает английский, упрощённый китайский, русский
и испанский тексты. При значении Auto мод использует язык игры, если он
поддерживается. Чтобы выбрать язык вручную или создать перевод, откройте
BepInEx\plugins\Assets\CasualtyVitals\ и задайте [Localization] Language в
BepInEx\config\CasualtyVitals.cfg.

Español: Casualty Vitals incluye textos en inglés, chino simplificado, ruso y
español. Con Auto, el mod usa el idioma del juego cuando está disponible. Para
elegir un idioma manualmente o crear una traducción, revisa
BepInEx\plugins\Assets\CasualtyVitals\ y configura [Localization] Language
en BepInEx\config\CasualtyVitals.cfg.

[size=4]Requirements[/size]

- Casualties Unknown Demo
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/341]CUCoreLib[/url]
- BepInEx 5 for Unity Mono
- Windows x64 game install

CUCoreLib is required for the custom medical solution items. Casualty Vitals declares it as a hard dependency, so BepInEx will refuse to load this mod if CUCoreLib is missing.

[size=4]Installation[/size]

1. Install BepInEx 5 into the Casualties Unknown game folder.
2. Launch the game once so BepInEx creates its folders.
3. Install `CUCoreLib.dll` and
4. Copy `CasualtyVitals.dll` (and the associated Asset folder) into:

[code]
<Game Folder>\BepInEx\plugins\
[/code]
5. Launch the game.
6. Check `BepInEx\LogOutput.log` for:

[code]
Plugin CasualtyVitals is loaded.[/code]

The mod keeps normal runtime logging quiet. If the log grows rapidly, look for warnings/errors rather than routine status spam.

[size=4]What It Does[/size]

- Replaces the vanilla health-panel ECG display with a custom monitor overlay.
- Adds selectable waveform channels:
  - HEART
  - SPO2
  - RESP
  - ABP
  - ETCO2
- Lets channels be previewed by hovering and pinned by clicking.
- Adds fast channel blending to reduce flicker when the vanilla UI changes rapidly.
- Adds monitor alarm tinting instead of large alarm text covering the trace.
- Pulses affected channel buttons during alarms.
- Supports a photosensitive alarm mode with slower, softer flashing.
- Hides the custom health monitor during unchipped mode so the vanilla behavior can show through.
- Adds a manual pulse check for unchipped or low-information playthroughs.
- Adds custom electrolyte treatment items through CUCoreLib.
- Adds elder thornback dread effects with moodles, heartbeat audio, panic HR, and post-fight adrenaline crash.
- Adds optional gameplay complications that can push vanilla Body fields when enabled.

[size=4]Manual Defibrillator Support[/size]

The manual defibrillator minigame receives its own limited monitor overlay.

It shows:

- HEART
- SPO2
- ABP

It does not show:

- RESP
- ETCO2

AED/manual defib shocks create a short noisy electrical artifact on the heart trace. Higher manual defib charge, or AED shocks, make the artifact slightly more erratic and last a little longer. In unchipped mode, the manual defib monitor can still show the shock artifact while the normal health monitor stays hidden.

Manual defibrillators can also be made rarer in generic loot/trader pools, or made more fragile after each shock, through config. This does not intentionally nerf AEDs.

[size=4]Physiology Layer[/size]

Casualty Vitals reads the current Body state and turns it into monitor behavior instead of only drawing the raw vanilla ECG.

Supported/estimated complication patterns include:

- Hypovolemia
- Hypoxia
- Respiratory failure
- Shock
- Angina/chest discomfort
- Ventricular instability
- Waterlogging/drowning-like respiratory stress
- Hyperkalemia from banana overload
- Hypercalcemia from electrolyte medication overdose
- Electrolyte medication toxicity
- Elder thornback panic/adrenaline states
- EtCO2 changes from ventilation, obstruction, waterlogging, perfusion, shock, and external API modifiers

These conditions are progressive. The monitor should often show deterioration before the raw numbers look completely catastrophic.

[size=4]Waveform Changes[/size]

The monitor can display:

- Sinus rhythm
- Bradycardia
- Tachycardia
- SVT-like fast rhythm
- VTach (now explicitly organized, monomorphic wide-complex)
- VFib (now fades in continuously instead of snapping)
- PEA-like electrical activity with poor/no perfusion
- Asystole (now decays gradually instead of snapping flat)
- Defib shock artifacts
- Hyperkalemia morphology with reduced P waves and tall peaked T waves
- Respiratory distress, apnea, waterlogged, and agonal-like patterns
- Pleth quality loss with poor oxygen/perfusion
- ABP loss with low pressure, low blood volume, arrest, or severe ventricular instability
- Synthetic/robotic ABP morphology when a charged autopump appears to be actively supporting low pressure
- EtCO2 plateau changes, including higher/waterlogged patterns

[size=4]Manual Pulse Checks[/size]

Holding left click with an empty cursor on the head, wrist, hand, or forearm in the health panel reveals a faint manual pulse trace after a short hold. This is mainly for unchipped playthroughs, but it can also be used in normal runs if you want a rough second opinion without relying fully on the monitor (for some reason?).

The manual trace is intentionally approximate. Higher intelligence improves interpretation: estimates appear with fewer beats, the BPM number tightens faster, and the trace is a little cleaner. Low intelligence takes longer and produces a rougher read.

During or near fibrillation, the manual pulse check becomes hard to interpret instead of giving a clean diagnostic VFib strip. If the patient is crashing that badly, the pulse check should feel like a warning sign, not a perfect monitor.

[size=4]Mod API[/size]

Casualty Vitals v1.0.0+ exposes `CasualtyVitalsApi` for other BepInEx mods. This allows other mods to safely read `VitalsSnapshot` without touching vanilla fields, inject additive condition burdens (`ExternalConditionSignal`), or apply custom waveform modifiers.

[size=4]Gameplay Effects[/size]

The mod can be used as a mostly visual monitor upgrade, or as a gameplay-affecting complication layer.

When `EnableGameplayEffects` is enabled, developing conditions can nudge vanilla Body fields. This can affect stamina, shock, chest pain, abdomen pain, hemothorax pressure, oxygen, respiratory behavior, blood pressure behavior, and fibrillation risk.

The goal is not instant punishment. The goal is to make subtle monitor deterioration matter.

Major gameplay-facing additions include:

- Hyperkalemia can progress from repeated banana eating and can contribute to chest pain, ECG changes, ventricular instability, and fibrillation risk if ignored.
- Hypercalcemia can occur from calcium gluconate overdose and can push angina/rhythm burden.
- Calcium gluconate and calcitonin solution are real custom items, not renamed vanilla saline.
- Both solutions can be consumed orally from the radial menu or injected through the health panel.
- Oral use takes about 14 mL and acts slowly with lower overdose risk.
- Injection uses the syringe minigame and can deliver much more at once, so overdose is easier.
- Each bottle holds 100 mL; injecting more than about 30 mL of either medication is the danger zone.
- Electrolyte medication overdose adds its own chipped-only moodle instead of pretending to be opiate overdose.
- Elder thornbacks can trigger Sense of Impending Doom, Horrified, and Focused moodles, boost heartbeat audio, and push panic heart rate toward a configurable maximum.
- After a thornback encounter ends, the heartbeat fades down over time and the adrenaline crash can lightly drain stamina.
- Thornback panic suppresses the monitor's hypertensive crisis reaction so dread HR spikes do not immediately become a hypertensive crisis by themselves.

For multiplayer, host-driven gameplay effects are the safest setup. Client-only monitor display is much safer than multiple clients writing vanilla Body fields at the same time (but it does work in a multiplayer setup, or well shouldn't break anything).

[size=4]Custom Medical Items[/size]

CUCoreLib registers two electrolyte solution items:

- `Calcium Gluconate Solution`
- `Calcitonin Solution`

Both use embedded sprites, spawn in medical loot pools, and can occasionally appear at traders. They are liquid containers with 100 mL of solution, custom liquid colors, custom locale text, and health-panel injection support.

Calcium gluconate stabilizes dangerous hyperkalemia. Calcitonin counteracts hypercalcemia after electrolyte treatment overdose. They are meant to be dosed carefully: partial oral doses are safer and slower, while health-panel injection is faster but can overdose hard if you dump too much.

[size=4]Banana Hyperkalemia[/size]

Because someone had to make potassium a gameplay mechanic:

- Eating more than about 1.5 bananas inside roughly 3 minutes starts the risk.
- Each extra half-banana step after that rolls a 50% chance.
- Each failed roll adds hyperkalemia progress.
- A very unlucky binge can max out the condition.
- Hyperkalemia decays by itself, but very slowly.
- Hyperkalemia contributes to angina burden, chest discomfort, abdomen discomfort, ventricular instability, ECG changes, and fibrillation risk (if enabled).

[size=4]Configuration[/size]

After first launch, BepInEx creates:

[code]
<Game Folder>\BepInEx\config\CasualtyVitals.cfg[/code]
Useful settings:

[code]
[Complications]
EnableGameplayEffects = false
EnableAutoPumpDiscomfort = false
EnableThornbackDread = true

[Accessibility]
PhotosensitiveAlarmMode = false

[Monitor]
ProcessingDelayMs = 120
WaveformTimeScale = 0.85

[Localization]
Language = Auto

[Thornback Dread]
AuraDistance = 28
PanicDistance = 9.5
MaxHeartRate = 200
PeakHoldSeconds = 4.5
CrashStaminaDrain = 0.18

[Manual Pulse ECG]
EnableManualPulseEcg = true
HoldSeconds = 3.5
HistoryScale = 1.4
HeadOffsetX = 0
HeadOffsetY = 0
LeftHandOffsetX = 0
LeftHandOffsetY = 0
RightHandOffsetX = 0
RightHandOffsetY = 0

[Manual Defibrillator]
LootChanceMultiplier = 1
ShockConditionLoss = 0

[Debug]
EnableDebugHotkeys = false[/code]
EnableGameplayEffects = false keeps the monitor behavior without letting the complication layer push vanilla Body fields.

EnableThornbackDread` is separate from `EnableGameplayEffects; turn it off if you only want the monitor/items/API without thornback panic physiology.

PhotosensitiveAlarmMode = true uses slower, softer alarm pulses.

ProcessingDelayMs tunes visual delay against the game's heartbeat/audio feel.

Localization.Language accepts Auto, EN, zh_CN, zh_TW, ru_RU, es_ES,
or es-419. Auto reads Casualties Unknown's current locale identifier every time
it refreshes custom text. zh_TW currently uses the supplied Chinese fallback and
es-419 uses the supplied Spanish fallback; they are recognized rather than falling
back to English. Unsupported game languages, missing files, invalid JSON, and
missing keys use built-in English. The JSON files in
BepInEx\plugins\Assets\CasualtyVitals are simple key/value text files and may be
translated or overridden.

The health-panel waveform follows the game's unscaled heartbeat clock and redraws each frame for smooth motion. Physiology still progresses on scaled game time.

Manual pulse ECG offsets are in screen pixels. The config comments include rough presets such as next-to-body, under-limb, and above-limb. The probe also nudges away if it would cover the limb being checked.

LootChanceMultiplier = 0 removes manual defibrillators from generic loot/trader pools. Values above `1` make them more common there. Direct special-case world spawns may still be controlled by the base game.

ShockConditionLoss only applies to the manual defibrillator. The AED is not intentionally affected.

[size=4]Debug Hotkeys[/size]

Debug hotkeys are disabled by default. Enable them in the config if you want to test the monitor quickly.

- F7 - hemorrhage / hypovolemia
- F8 - hypoxia
- F9 - ventricular instability
- F10 - thoracic / respiratory complication
- F11 - PEA-like state
[size=1]These hotkeys intentionally alter the current patient.[/size]

This mod also adds console commands for testing internal values:

[code]
cvlistbodyfields
cvsetbodyfield <field> <value> [seconds]
cvgetbodyfield <field>[/code]
[size=4]Compatibility[/size]

This mod is a BepInEx plugin that overlays and disables specific vanilla ECG UI components while active. It may conflict with mods that replace the same health-panel ECG, wound panel, or manual defibrillator minigame UI.

It should be compatible with unrelated item, world, audio, and quality-of-life mods unless they heavily alter the same UI or Body fields.

(as should be noted that this mod looks for "WoundView" so if any mod alters it in ways that CasualtyVitals can't see it properly, it might break, but by itself does not alter this class.)

[size=4]Known Limitations[/size]

- The mod estimates some hidden game states because not every useful Body/device detail is exposed cleanly.
- Autopump activity is inferred from pressure behavior and wearable/battery state.
- The monitor is stylized for Casualties Unknown rather than a strict medical simulator.
- Some severe or nonsensical vanilla states can still produce odd combinations, because Casualties Unknown allows odd physiology.
- The manual defib monitor is intentionally limited and not perfectly accurate.
- Manual pulse checks are approximate and intentionally affected by intelligence.
- Gameplay-affecting complications should generally be host-driven in multiplayer.
- CUCoreLib must load before the custom solution items can register.
- Setting the heartRate too high may lead to a game crash (but this is usually in the billions so it's fine in NORMAL gameplay.)

[size=4]Troubleshooting[/size]

If the monitor does not appear:

- Confirm BepInEx 5 loads.
- Confirm CasualtyVitals.dll is in BepInEx\plugins.
- Confirm CUCoreLib.dll is in BepInEx\plugins`.
- Confirm LogOutput.log contains Plugin CasualtyVitals is loaded.
- Open the health/wound panel; the overlay attaches to the game's ECG UI.
- If using other UI mods, try disabling anything that changes the health panel or defibrillator UI.

- If all else fails, try to change BepInEx's "HideManagerGameObject = false" to true.

If the log file gets noisy:

- Check for repeated warnings or errors from Casualty Vitals.
- Routine status messages are intentionally suppressed.
- Debug hotkey messages only appear when debug hotkeys are enabled and pressed.

If alarm flashing is uncomfortable:

- Set PhotosensitiveAlarmMode = true.

[size=4]Uninstall[/size]

Delete:

[code]
<Game Folder>\BepInEx\plugins\CasualtyVitals.dll
[/code]
Optional:

[code]
<Game Folder>\BepInEx\config\CasualtyVitals.cfg
<Game Folder>\BepInEx\plugins\Assets\CasualtyVitals
[/code]
[size=1]If no other mod requires CUCoreLib.dll you can also delete it.[/size]

[size=4]Credits[/size]

- Built with BepInEx 5.
- Inspired by the [url=https://github.com/ThatOneFBIAgent/VitalSignSimulator]StatPatMon/VitalSign Monitor[/url] simulation work (outside app of mine).
- Developed for experimental Casualties Unknown medical-monitor modding.

[size=4]For the developers[/size]
[size=3]Please visit [url=https://github.com/ThatOneFBIAgent/CasualtyVitals/blob/main/API.md]the public repo[/url] for documentation on how to interact with the mod.[/size]
[size=4]
Version[/size]

Current workspace version: 1.3.0

This build is experimental and may change as the underlying game and mod hooks are better understood.
