Name: Pet Mod
Description:
[size=6][b]Cosmetic Pet Mod for Casualties Unknown[/b][/size]

Welcome to the [b]Cosmetic Pet Mod[/b], a companion experience for [i]Casualties Unknown[/i] with smooth physics-based following, advanced multiplayer synchronization, and full audio support!

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[size=5][b]🚀 KEY FEATURES & MECHANICS[/b][/size]
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

[size=4][b]1. 🦘 Physics-Based Follow Behavior[/b][/size]
[*][b]Horizontal Lag:[/b] Trails behind you at a configurable follow distance with smooth exponential interpolation — no rigid snapping.[/*]
[*][b]Auto-Flipping:[/b] Detects your facing direction (or movement delta) with a 150ms hysteresis lock to prevent rapid flutter, always looking the correct way.[/*]
[*][b]Teleport Protection:[/b] Two-tier guard — soft reset above 8 units, hard snap above 18 units — stops the pet from warping across the screen during fast movement.

[size=4][b]2. 🌍 Auto-Leveling Ground System[/b][/size][/*]
[*][b]Multi-Raycast Sampling:[/b] Three rays span the pet's left, center, and right edges to bridge 1-tile gaps and step smoothly over terrain.[/*]
[*][b]One-Way Platform Filtering:[/b] Ignores pass-through platforms unless the player is standing on or very close to them.[/*]
[*][b]Spring-Damper Suspension:[/b] [color=#f1c40f]Mathf.SmoothDamp[/color] ground interpolation with a small threshold gate ([color=#f1c40f]0.35u[/color]) to suppress flat-ground micro-jitter while still gliding over stairs.[/*]
[*][b]Item Ignore:[/b] The pet sees through all dropped/physical world items — no snapping onto boxes or bags.

[size=4][b]3. 🪟 Smart Ceiling Squishing[/b][/size][/*]
[*][b]Lookahead Pre-Pass:[/b] Ceiling scanning starts [i]before[/i] the pet enters an overhang, triggered from a stable origin point above the player.[/*]
[*][b]Accurate Clearance:[/b] Measured from the pet's actual bottom edge, not the player origin.[/*]
[*][b]Asymmetric Interpolation:[/b] Compresses 2.5× faster than it expands for a satisfying jelly squish feel.[/*]
[*][b]Minimum Squish Cap:[/b] Pet can compress down to [b]0.15×[/b] its height to squeeze through very tight gaps.[/*]
[*][b]Ceiling-Aware Wall Rays:[/b] Horizontal wall collision checks are clamped below detected ceilings so the pet can slide sideways without corner-snagging.

[size=4][b]4. 💃 Walking Wiggle & Squash-and-Stretch[/b][/size][/*]
[*][b]Tilt Wiggle:[/b] [color=#f1c40f]Mathf.Sin[/color]-driven left/right rotation when walking.[/*]
[*][b]Squash & Stretch:[/b] Vertical compression and horizontal expansion synchronized to stride rhythm.

[size=4][b]5. 🛸 Simple Mode (Noclip)[/b][/size]
Toggle [b]Simple Mode[/b] to bypass all collision checks entirely. The pet smoothly hovers and bobs alongside you, gliding freely through any geometry. Walk wiggles remain active. Useful if you experience physics issues in unusual map geometry.

[size=4][b]6. 🔊 Audio Pack Support (Up to 500%)[/b][/size]
Drop WAV, OGG, or MP3 files into an audio pack folder and the pet will randomly play them on a configurable interval:[/*]
[*][b]500% Volume Cap:[/b] Volume goes up to [b]5.0×[/b] using [color=#f1c40f]PlayOneShot[/color] to bypass Unity's standard [color=#f1c40f]1.0[/color] clamp.[/*]
[*][b]Configurable Intervals:[/b] Set minimum and maximum seconds between sounds independently.

[size=4][b]7. 🛡️ 100% Invincibility[/b][/size]
A pure cosmetic companion — no colliders, no health, completely immune to game physics, enemies, and player collision.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[size=5][b]🌐 MULTIPLAYER SYNCHRONIZATION[/b][/size]
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

An industry-grade P2P and Steam Lobby sync architecture so everyone in your session sees (and hears!) your pet perfectly.

[size=4][b]👥 Personalized Follow Dynamics[/b][/size]
All movement parameters ([i]Follow Speed, Follow Distance, Wiggle Speed[/i], etc.) are client-authoritative and broadcast via Steam lobby member metadata. Each player's pet moves with their chosen settings, independently per-player.

[size=4][b]🖼️ P-2-P Custom PNG Transfer[/b][/size]
When you load a custom local skin that other players don't have, the mod automatically transfers it:
1. Remote clients detect a new SHA1 hash via lobby metadata.
2. They issue a reliable P2P request on Channel [b]1337[/b].
3. You send the raw image bytes directly.
4. They cache it by hash in [color=#1abc9c]Pets/Cache/[/color] for instant loading next session.

[size=4][b]🎵 Multiplayer Audio Sync[/b][/size]
When your pet plays a sound, a tiny 6-byte P2P packet (type [b]2[/b], unreliable delivery) is broadcast to all lobby members. Each receiver plays the clip on their local copy of your pet's [i]AudioSource[/i], positioned in 3D space at the pet's location. If a player doesn't have your audio pack installed, they simply hear nothing — no crash, no error.

[size=4][b]🤫 Anti-Jitter Motion Filtering[/b][/size][/*]
[*]Position deadzone [i]0.02u/frame[/i] to suppress floating-point noise when standing still.[/*]
[*]Facing-direction flip locked behind [i]0.05u[/i] movement delta and 150ms sustain timer.[/*]
[*]Low-pass velocity smoothing so walk animations start and stop organically.

[size=4][b]📥 Importing Custom Sprites[/b][/size]
[b]Method A — Drop files:[/b]
Place [color=#1abc9c].png[/color] files into [color=#1abc9c]BepInEx/plugins/CosmeticPetMod/Pets/[/color] and they appear in the settings list immediately.

[b]Method B — In-game importer:[/b]
Paste a full file path or direct image URL into the settings window and click [b]Import Image File / URL[/b]. The mod downloads, caches, and applies it mid-session.

Create a folder inside [color=#1abc9c]BepInEx/plugins/CosmeticPetMod/AudioPacks/<pack_name>/[/color] and place [color=#1abc9c].wav[/color], [color=#1abc9c].ogg[/color], or [color=#1abc9c].mp3[/color] files inside. Name: Manual Breathing
Description:
[size=6][b]Manual Breathing Mod — Technical Overview & Design[/b][/size]

This mod introduces a high-fidelity, immersive, and tactile [b]Manual Respiration System[/b] to [i]Casualties Unknown[/i], completely transforming the gameplay loop by requiring the player to actively manage their inhalation and exhalation cycle to maintain cellular oxygenation.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[size=5][b]🧬 RESPIRATION MECHANICS & LUNG SIMULATION[/b][/size]
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Rather than treating breathing as a binary state, the mod implements an organic, physical model of the human respiratory tract:

[size=4][b]1. The Respiratory State Model[/b][/size]
Each conscious local player's body tracks two continuous properties:
[*][b]Lung Volume ([color=#f1c40f]lungAir[/color]) [0.0 - 1.0]:[/b] The physical volume of gas currently occupying the lungs.[/*]
[*][b]Oxygen Freshness ([color=#f1c40f]lungFreshness[/color]) [0.0 - 1.0]:[/b] The concentration of fresh, absorbable oxygen vs. accumulated, stale carbon dioxide.

[size=4][b]2. Anatomical Dead Space Simulation (Capped Freshness)[/b][/size]
To prevent a single inhale from magically "fully charging" the respiratory system to 100% capacity from an empty state, the mod models [b]Anatomical Dead Space[/b] (the residual volume of stale air trapped in non-exchanging airways).

During inhalation, incoming ambient air is mixed with a maximum fresh efficiency of [b]0.85[/b] instead of a perfect 1.0:

[code]lungFreshness_new = ((lungFreshness * lungAir_prev) + (0.85 * addedAir)) / lungAir_new[/code]
This means your lungs always maintain a realistic residual mixing of gases, preventing instantaneous maximum charges and forcing a consistent ventilatory rhythm.

[size=4][b]3. Deep Inhale Alveolar Boost (Low-Volume Efficiency)[/b][/size]
Gas exchange is most efficient at low lung volumes where the partial pressure gradient of oxygen is steepest. The mod rewards realistic deep breathing cycles by introducing the [b]Deep Inhale Alveolar Boost[/b]:[/*]
[*][b]Inhaling at low lung volumes[/b] ([color=#f1c40f]lungAir[/color] close to 0) directly adds a substantial amount of oxygen to your blood ([color=#f1c40f]bloodOxygen[/color]).[/*]
[*][b]Inhaling at high lung volumes[/b] (shallow breathing/panting at the top, e.g., from 0.8 to 1.0) provides [b]virtually zero[/b] direct blood oxygen gain.

[code]ΔbloodOxygen = addedAir * (1.0 - lungAir_prev)^2 * 32.0[/code]
This makes shallow, rapid inhalations highly ineffective, forcing the player to fully empty their lungs ([color=#f1c40f]lungAir[/color] to 0.0) before taking deep breaths to maximize oxygen absorption!

[size=4][b]4. Metabolic Oxygen Depletion[/b][/size]
Oxygen is constantly consumed from the lungs. The rate of depletion scales dynamically with the character's physical state:[/*]
[*][b]Baseline Consumption:[/b] It takes approximately 22 seconds of breath-holding to fully deplete oxygen under quiet conditions.[/*]
[*][b]Cardiovascular Scale:[/b] High heart rate ([color=#e74c3c]body.respiratoryRate[/color]) increases oxygen consumption.[/*]
[*][b]Exertion Scale:[/b] Low stamina ([color=#e74c3c]body.stamina[/color]) indicates high fatigue, compounding oxygen consumption up to [b]2.2x faster[/b].

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[size=5][b]🫁 VENTILATION RATE RISKS (NEW PHYSIOLOGY)[/b][/size]
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

The mod features a sophisticated, real-time [b]Ventilation Rate and Rhythm Tracker[/b] that monitors the duration and frequency of your breathing phases. Deviations from a steady, natural cycle introduce severe physiological and visual penalties.

[size=4][b]1. Hyperventilation (Breathing Too Fast)[/b][/size]
Triggered by rapid, shallow tapping (breathing phase duration less than [b]0.85s[/b]), which simulates hypocapnia (extreme depletion of blood carbon dioxide leading to respiratory alkalosis):[/*]
[*][b]Lightheadedness & Drowsiness:[/b] Your consciousness ([color=#e74c3c]body.consciousness[/color]) is continuously drained. If it falls below 30%, you pass out.[/*]
[*][b]Dizziness Camera Sway:[/b] The camera sways gently in a circular sinusoidal motion, mimicking a spinning head.[/*]
[*][b]Muscle Twitches & Jitter:[/b] Under extreme hyperventilation (level > 50%), the player experiences high-frequency tremors (muscles spasming due to alkalosis), making the camera shake rapidly.[/*]
[*][b]Staggering Slowdown:[/b] Lightheadedness saps coordination, slowing down character movement speed up to [b]36%[/b].[/*]
[*][b]Peripheral Glare Vignette:[/b] A vibrant, flickering white-blue glare border vibrates at 20Hz around the screen edges, blinding peripheral vision.

[size=4][b]2. Hypoventilation (Breathing Too Slow / Holding Breath)[/b][/size]
Triggered by prolonged inactivity, holding breath, or holding a single key down without cycling (duration greater than [b]5.5s[/b]), which simulates hypercapnia (severe CO2 retention and respiratory acidosis):[/*]
[*][b]CO2 Retention Fatigue:[/b] Blood oxygen ([color=#f1c40f]bloodOxygen[/color]) is actively destroyed by hypercapnia.[/*]
[*][b]Anoxic Exhaustion:[/b] Stamina ([color=#e74c3c]stamina[/color]) rapidly drains due to toxic lactic acid build-up in muscles.[/*]
[*][b]Severe Tachycardia:[/b] Heart rate surges up to 195 bpm to compensate for oxygen deprivation.[/*]
[*][b]Cardiac Throb Camera Shake:[/b] The screen physically throbs and shakes in [b]perfect synchronization[/b] with your actual heart rate ([color=#e74c3c]body.heartRate[/color]), simulating high-pressure pulsing blood.[/*]
[*][b]Sluggish Exhaustion:[/b] Movement speed is slowed by up to 30%.[/*]
[*][b]Claustrophobic Tunnel Vision:[/b] A dark, heavy charcoal vignette starts closing in from the screen boundaries, squeezing your field of view down to a narrow slit.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[size=5][b]🌊 UNDERWATER ASPHYXIATION HAZARDS[/b][/size]
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

If the player submerges in water without a Scuba Gear accessory:[/*]
[*]Inhaling draws in water instead of air, instantly dropping [color=#f1c40f]lungFreshness[/color] to [b]0.0[/b].[/*]
[*]Water inhalation induces [b]alveolar trauma[/b], dealing steady, direct damage to [color=#e74c3c]body.brainHealth[/color].[/*]
[*]Choking and coughing sounds are triggered at random, short intervals to communicate panic.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[size=5][b]🎛️ PROCEDURAL RESPIRATION AUDIO SYNTHESIZER[/b][/size]
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

The mod synthesizes breathing audio [b]procedurally in real-time[/b] on startup. This completely eliminates loading lag and guarantees high portability.

[size=4][b]The DSP Filter Pipeline[/b][/size][/*]
[*][b]Noise Source:[/b] Generates uniform white noise samples.[/*]
[*][b]RC Lowpass Filter:[/b] Airway geometry shifts during breathing. The synthesizer uses an RC lowpass filter with a dynamic coefficient (alpha):
    * [b]Inhaling:[/b] Air passages dilate, allowing higher-frequency transmission. Alpha ramps up dynamically to widen the filter.
    * [b]Exhaling:[/b] Air passages relax and constrict. Alpha ramps down to produce a warm, deep, muffled wind sound.[/*]
[*][b]Volume Envelope:[/b] Smooth sinusoidal contours with click-softening boundaries on the edges to simulate realistic lung expansion and contraction.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[size=5][b]🖥️ DYNAMIC GLASSMORPHIC HUD & VIGNETTES[/b][/size]
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

The HUD is designed to feel cohesive, luxurious, and completely integrated into the game's atmosphere:

[size=4][b]1. Organic Fading (Dynamic Visibility)[/b][/size]
The HUD remains completely hidden while the player is healthy and resting to maximize screen space. It smoothly fades into view (alpha transitions via [i]Time.deltaTime * 3.5f[/i]) only when:
1. The player is actively pressing Inhale/Exhale keys.
2. Blood oxygen falls below 88%, lung freshness drops below 35%, or ventilation rates become unstable.
3. The character is submerged underwater.

[size=4][b]2. Progressive Blackouts[/b][/size]
As consciousness drops below 55% due to hyperventilation or hypoxia, the screen gradually fades out to complete black, perfectly simulating passing out right before the character collapses into a limp ragdoll.

[size=4][b]3. Beautiful Interface Aesthetics[/b][/size][/*]
[*][b]Glassmorphic backing panel:[/b] A semi-transparent dark charcoal panel with crisp slate borders.[/*]
[*][b]Dual Micro-Progress Bars:[/b]
    * [b]Lungs Bar:[/b] Changes color organically from [b][color=#9b59b6]deep magenta-purple[/color][/b] (stale/carbon dioxide) to [b][color=#1abc9c]vibrant electric-teal[/color][/b] (fresh oxygen).
    * [b]Blood Oxygen Bar:[/b] Transitions from emerald green to amber orange, culminating in an [b][color=#e74c3c]urgent flashing crimson[/color][/b] during extreme hypoxia.[/*]
[*][b]Hypoxia Vignette:[/b] When blood oxygen drops below 50%, the entire screen starts thumping with a glowing, pulse-modulated full-screen crimson warning vignette.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[size=5][b]⚙️ CONFIGURATION & MODSETTINGSLIB INTEGRATION[/b][/size]
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

The mod features [b]seamless native integration[/b] with [b]ModSettingsLib[/b] (the official, standard menu configuration library for [i]Casualties Unknown[/i]).

[size=4][b]1. Robust Soft Dependency Architecture[/b][/size]
The mod is built using a resilient soft-dependency pattern:[/*]
[*][b]If ModSettingsLib is installed:[/b] The mod automatically registers a beautifully designed, native configuration tab under the game's "Mod Settings" menu. The player can adjust and rebind all breathing settings in-game with real-time feedback.[/*]
[*][b]If ModSettingsLib is missing:[/b] The mod gracefully falls back to using the standard BepInEx .cfg configuration file without throwing any assembly load errors or crashing.

[size=4][b]2. Localization & Description Registration[/b][/size]
The mod plugs into the game's native localization system ([i]Locale.currentLang.other[/i]) to inject highly descriptive titles, keybind labels, and interactive hover tips:[/*]
[*][b]Tab Title:[/b] Manual Breathing[/*]
[*][b]Enable Mod:[/b] Manual Breathing Mod — [i]Enable or disable all manual breathing mechanics and HUD features.[/i][/*]
[*][b]Inhale Key:[/b] Inhale Key — [i]The key you hold down to draw fresh air into your lungs.[/i][/*]
[*][b]Exhale Key:[/b] Exhale Key — [i]The key you hold down to push stale carbon dioxide out of your lungs.[/i][/*]
[*][b]Autonomic Respiration:[/b] Autonomic Respiration (Sleep) — [i]If true, your character will breathe automatically (slowly/shallowly) while unconscious. If false, you will suffocate.[/i]

[size=4][b]3. Real-Time Dynamic Synchronization[/b][/size]
No restarts required! Any changes made in the in-game "Mod Settings" tab are:
1. Instantly updated in the game's runtime memory.
2. Dynamically picked up by the BreathingController in real-time.
3. Automatically saved to disk back into the BepInEx config file.

Name: Manual Blinking
Description:
[size=6][b]Manual Blinking & Focus Mod 👁️[/b][/size]

An immersive, high-stakes physiological simulation mod for [b]Casualties Unknown[/b]. This mod replaces passive visual clarity with a manual ocular regulation loop. Players must periodically blink to moisten their eyes, manage ocular dryness under harsh environmental conditions, and survive high-tension involuntary squinting or forced blinking during critical gameplay moments.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[size=5][b]CORE MECHANICS[/b][/size]
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

[size=4][b]1. The Dryness Loop (drynessLevel)[/b][/size]
[*]Your eyes dry out naturally over time.[/*]
[*][b]Base Dryness Rate:[/b] Takes roughly [i]0.8 seconds[/i] (with default [color=#f1c40f]BaseDrySpeed = 1.25f[/color]) to go from fully hydrated to dangerously dry. This ensures players must blink regularly and keep watch of ocular state.[/*]
[*][b]Environmental & Physical Scaling:[/b]
    * [b]Wind / Movement Velocity:[/b] Movement speed (retrieved via [color=#e74c3c]body.rb.velocity[/color]) pushes air into your eyes, increasing dry-out speed by up to [b]2.2x[/b] at terminal velocities.
    * [b]Submersion (inWater):[/b] Opening eyes underwater or getting splashed increases irritation and salt/chlorine drying by [b]3.0x[/b].
    * [b]Severe Injury / Pain:[/b] Ocular fatigue increases under intense pain or high heart rate.

[size=4][b]2. Manual Blinking & Eye Closure[/b][/size][/*]
[*][b]Manual Blink Key:[/b] Pressing a single key (default: [b]CapsLock[/b]) triggers a quick blink cycle, resetting [color=#f1c40f]drynessLevel[/color] back to [color=#f1c40f]0.0f[/color].[/*]
[*][b]Ocular Focus (Holding closed):[/b] Keeping the blink key held down closes your eyelids permanently.
    * [b]Smooth Cinematic Fading:[/b] Instead of instantly snapping dark, the eyelids fade to dark [b]really fast[/b] (~0.06 seconds) when closed, and fade back to normal [b]slightly slower[/b] (~0.25 seconds) when released, providing a smooth visual transition.
    * [b]Benefits:[/b] Rapidly relieves dryness, aids in recovering from temporary blindness (e.g., flashes/glare), and dampens intense camera shakes.
    * [b]Consequence:[/b] Complete blackout—you are blind to your surroundings while your eyes are closed.

[size=4][b]3. The Threat: Dry Eye Penalties[/b][/size]
As [i]drynessLevel[/i] passes certain thresholds, your ocular control degrades progressively:[/*]
[*][b]Stage 1: Cinematic Squint (> 40% Dryness):[/b] Two dark cinematic eyelid bands close in from the top and bottom of the screen, physically narrowing your vertical field of view to simulate squinting through dry irritation.[/*]
[*][b]Stage 2: Stinging Red Vignette & Violent Spasms (> 50% Dryness):[/b]
    * A custom, procedurally generated red vignette crawls onto the edges of your screen and pulsates, simulating throbbing eyeball irritation.
    * Visual camera twitches and muscle spasms increase in frequency and violence as dryness reaches 100%.[/*]
[*][b]Stage 3: Stamina Drain, Slowdown & Pain Groans (> 70% Dryness):[/b]
    * [i]No Automatic Blinking:[/i] You will [b]never[/b] automatically blink when it is too late. You must manage eye closure manually.
    * [i]Stamina Exhaustion (> 70% Dryness):[/i] Eye strain drains body stamina ([i]body.stamina[/i]) steadily over time.
    * [i]Slowdown (> 85% Dryness):[/i] Movement velocity slows down as severe eye irritation disrupts spatial coordination.
    * [i]Agony Vocalizations (100% Dryness):[/i] Stinging eye pain triggers periodic choking or gasping vocalizations from your player character.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[size=5][b]TECHNICAL ARCHITECTURE[/b][/size]
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

[size=4][b]Plugin.cs[/b][/size][/*]
[*]Initializes the BepInEx plugin and hooks into [i]Body.HandleCirculation[/i] to dynamically inject the [i]BlinkingController[/i] component onto the player character.[/*]
[*]Handles native configuration bindings ([i]ConfigEntry[/i]) for blink keybinds, dry-out speed multipliers, and visual scales.[/*]
[*]Registers with [b]ModSettingsLib[/b] (soft dependency) to add an [b]"Ocular Care / Manual Blinking"[/b] settings tab directly inside the game's native options screen, allowing toggleable configurations and custom keys.

[size=4][b]BlinkingController.cs[/b][/size][/*]
[*]Maintains the state variables ([i]drynessLevel, blinkProgress, isBlinking[/i], etc.).[/*]
[*]Monitors physical speed via [i]body.rb.velocity.magnitude[/i] and environmental factors.[/*]
[*]Features a custom [i]OnGUI()[/i] HUD layer that draws:
    * [b]The Cinematic Eyelid Squint:[/b] Dual horizontal black boxes expanding towards the center as dryness rises.
    * [b]The Complete Blackout:[/b] Fullscreen fade-to-black when eyes are closed or blinking.
    * [b]Ocular Tension Indicators:[/b] Optional small icon/warning prompts under extreme strain.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[size=5][b]PROPOSED INTEGRATION FLOW[/b][/size]
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

[code]
Player Body --> Injects Component --> BlinkingController
                                          |
    +--------------------------------------+------------------------------------+
    |                                      |                                    |
Checks Physics                        Checks Environment                  Reads Controls
(body.rb.velocity.magnitude)          (body.inWater)                      (Plugin.ConfigBlinkKey)
    |                                      |                                    |
    +--------------------------------------+------------------------------------+
                                          |
                                  Calculates State
                                    (drynessLevel)
                                          |
          +--------------------------------+--------------------------------+
          |                                |                                |
    Dryness > 40%                    Dryness > 65%                    Dryness = 100%
          |                                |                                |
Draw Cinematic Squint OnGUI      Induce Camera Jitter & Blur      Trigger Forced 0.9s Blackout

* Note: Holding or pressing the ConfigBlinkKey triggers the Blink Cycle & resets dryness.[/code]
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Name: ExpSneeze
Description:
Adds a sneezing mechanic to Casualties: Unknown.

Sneezes build up slowly over the course of 7.5 minutes on their own, but are accelerated by digging (getting dust in your nose!). When you're ready to sneeze, you'll start sneezing a random number of times, briefly losing consciousness, receiving mild knockback, and losing 1% of your stamina for each sneeze. There is also a 1 in 10 chance for you to drop whatever you're holding in your mouth each sneeze. You will never sneeze if you're wearing a dust mask!

All values are configurable in the game settings, tweak to your heart's content!

[size=5][b]Requires BepInEx and CUCoreLib![/b][/size]

Banner art by me :3

Name: Dont Press Wrong Number
Description:
[b][color=#ff7700][size=4]Description [/size][/color][/b]
This mod improves the Lifepod keypad minigame by adding a Backspace (<) button, allowing you to delete the last entered digit instead of clearing the entire code.
It also adds real-time color feedback:
[b]• [color=#1e84cc]Blue[/color][/b] = Correct digit
[b]• [color=#cc0000]Red[/color] [/b]= Incorrect digit

If you have any issues while playing or find any bugs, please leave a post!

[color=#ff7700][size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size][/color]
1. Download Mod
2. Put the Mod file in here : "Casualties Unknown Demo\BepInEx\plugins"
3. Play!

[color=#ff7700][size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#ffffff]Adds a Backspace (<) button to the Lifepod keypad[/color]

[b]• [url=https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx/releases/]BepInEx[/url][/b] For mod

Name: All Wearable Can Be Held
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Tired of juggling two packs or bags just to move items around? Wondering why a foliage bag with two ropes can't be carried in hand?
Now all wearable equipment — armor, backpacks, and everything else — can be held in hand and stored in your inventory.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]1. Make sure BepInEx is installed
2. Place "AllWearableCanBeHeld.dll" into "BepInEx/plugins/" folder
3. Launch the game[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]All wearable items (armor, backpacks, etc.) can now be equipped, held in hand, or stored in the inventory — just like an Autopump.
Does not affect any other stats or attributes of the items.
Multiplayer compatibility has not been tested yet — hopefully it works![/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]BepInEx (5.4.x)[/color]

[b][size=4]介绍[/size][/b]
厌恶了来回装备两个背包来倒腾道具吗？疑惑为什么加了两根背带的纤维袋就不能抓在手里了吗？
现在所有的装备（无论是护甲还是背包）都可以手持和放入道具栏了。

[b][size=4]安装方法[/size][/b]
1. 确保已安装 BepInEx
2. 将 AllWearableCanBeHeld.dll 放入 BepInEx/plugins/ 文件夹
3. 启动游戏即可

[b][size=4]功能[/size][/b]
所有能装备的道具（无论是护甲还是背包）都可以像自动泵那样，既能装备，也能手持和放入道具栏了。
不影响装备的其他数值。
尚未测试多人联机的兼容性——希望是兼容的。

[b]前置依赖[/b]
BepInEx (5.4.x)

Name: Lefty Expies
Description:
Make your Expies lefties! This mod makes it so that there's a chance that your Experiment will be left handed or ambidextrous when you start a new run. Left handed Expies prefer to use and default to their left hand instead of their right, and ambidextrous Expies can use both equally, but at a 10% damage penalty across the board as a trade off. Everything is configurable in the game settings!

I haven't tested this mod with multiplayer, use at your own risk.

A known issue is that if you load a save file, all future runs until you close the game will always have the same handedness. Not sure why, but a quick restart fixes it!

Currently has support for the following languages:
- English (Courtesy of myself)
- Spanish (Machine translated)
- Italian (Machine translated)
- Russian (Machine translated)
- Ukrainian (Machine translated)
- Vietnamese (Courtesy of InklessBrush)
- Simplified Chinese (Machine translated)
- Romanian (Machine translated)
- Korean (Machine Translated)

Please let me know if you find any errors or would like to contribute!

[size=5][b]Requires BepInEx and CUCoreLib![/b][/size]

[b]If the mod does not work:[/b]
1.  Open the BepInEx config at
[code]C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Casualties Unknown Demo\BepInEx\config\BepInEx.cfg[/code]2. Change HideManagerGameObject to true:[img]https://files.catbox.moe/y9wzou.png[/img]

Future ideas:
- Explicit multiplayer mod support

Name: VProfiler
Description:
VProfiler is a lightweight in-game performance monitoring mod for tracking runtime performance and diagnosing bottlenecks. It displays FPS, minimum FPS, maximum FPS, average FPS, 1% low FPS, GC memory, CPU/GPU frame time, network latency, bandwidth, packet counts, and Unity component-level CPU usage directly on screen.
The mod includes a real-time FPS graph using fixed-time sampling to keep latency low while avoiding abnormal V-shaped artifacts at the right edge of the chart. It is useful for debugging stutters, investigating performance issues, monitoring multiplayer network status, and comparing performance across different settings.

Main features:
[list]
[*]Real-time FPS, Min, Max, Avg, and 1% Low display[/*]
[*]FPS history graph[/*]
[*]GC memory and collection count tracking[/*]
[*]Unity main-thread CPU and GPU frame time display[/*]
[*]Unity component CPU usage breakdown[/*]
[*]Network ping, upload/download bandwidth, and packet statistics (Available when KrokMP is installed)[/*]
[*]Game system performance sampling and sorted display[/*]
[*]Hotkeys for toggling profiler panels[/*]
[/list]
Hotkeys:
[list]
[*]F6: Toggle FPS, GC, and network info[/*]
[*]F7: Toggle CPU, GPU, and Unity component analysis[/*]
[*]F8: Toggle game system performance analysis[/*]
[/list]Please install BepInEx to use this mod correctly. Optional: KrokMP

Description:
# gouxi's funnyshit

> A collection of weird ideas from G0ux1 – hope you enjoy them. All items are set to spawn naturally in-game. Some features are still WIP and will be updated later.

---

## 📦 Mod Overview

This mod adds a large variety of new items, liquids, and mechanics to *Scav Prototype*, covering equipment, food, medicine, tools, weapons, utilities, and special liquids. Everything is themed around the "Gouxi-Tech" universe – full of parody, dark humor, and adult-oriented content.

### 🎒 Equipment
- **Tail Pouch** – wearable container, increases carry capacity and reduces encumbrance.
- **Coyote?! (DG Lab)** – device that stabilizes heart rate and can act as an AED (use on chest).
- **Subspace Bag** – massive backpack with shielding, but risks annihilation when battery depletes.

### 🍖 Food
- **Raw Fish** – from another dimension, may cause sickness.
- **Cooked Steak** – perfectly cooked steak with odd texture, restores hunger and happiness.

### 💊 Medical
- **Golden Apple** – heals internal/external injuries and boosts happiness.
- **Nerve Block Neutralizer** – removes "mindwipe" aftereffects, forces high-quality sleep and resets INT.

### ⚒️ Tools/Weapons (3 tiers)
- **Stone tools** (pickaxe, sword, axe, hoe, shovel) – basic harvesting and combat.
- **Iron tools** – higher durability and damage.
- **Diamond tools** – top-tier stats, with amputation capability (use on infected non-leg limbs to trigger minigame).

- **Flint & Steel** – fire starter.
- **Fishing Rod** – cast and reel to pull yourself toward target and maybe catch a fish (mending).

### 🧩 Utilities / Misc
- **Brain Overclock** – boosts speed/jump but damages brain.
- **Doll series** (Gouxi, Black-White Wolf, Huaimeng, Xieuxiu, Shadow Fox, Huli, etc.) – interactive, each with unique effects (happiness, stamina drain, liquid collection, etc.).
- **Fireball** – throwable explosive with audio cue.
- **Experience Bottle** – smash for large XP and unlock a random recipe.
- **Nuke (two versions)** – one explodes directly, the other requires a defuse minigame (easter egg code `114514` triggers reward).
- **Chip Remover/Implanter** – toggles "chipped" state, affecting brain stats and abilities.
- **Eat-Explode Box** – randomly gives food or explodes (25% chance).
- **EXP Pet Ticket** – use on head for happiness and pain relief.
- **Glowstone Dust, Gold Ingot, Iron Ingot, Diamond, Wooden Stick** – crafting materials.
- **Russian Roulette** – use on head; 1/6 chance of full heal, otherwise instant death (durability consumption).

### 🧪 Liquid Containers
- **Iron Bucket** – holds any liquid for drinking.
- **Empty Bottle** – pre-filled with "Instant Healing II".
- **Mini Barrel Syringe** – huge-capacity injector, triggers an injection minigame; powerful but with severe side effects (heavy bleeding, fractures, brain damage).

### 🌊 Special Liquids (drinkable/injectable)
- **Serotonin** – inject to regulate mood, overdose causes depression.
- **Instant Healing II** – oral or topical/injection, restores skin, muscle, reduces infection.
- **"Milk" (cum)** – restores hunger/thirst but increases sickness; injection causes infection.
- **Orange Soda** – tasty but causes discomfort.
- **Sleeping Red Tea** – euphoric, then forces sleep after a short delay (with intense pain).

---

## 🔧 Special Mechanics

- **Amputation System**: Use swords/axes on severely infected non-leg limbs to trigger amputation minigame.
- **Nuke Defuse Minigame**: Enter correct code (randomly generated) to delay explosion; enter easter egg `114514` to get rewards.
- **Coyote AED Function**: Use on chest to start a CPR minigame.
- **Serotonin Homeostasis**: Injection amount affects happiness and negative effects; overdose resets.
- **Russian Roulette**: Dynamic probability (survival chance decreases with use), consumes 1/6 durability per shot.

---

## ⚠️ Important Notes

- **Compatibility**: This mod is built on `CUCoreLib` and **conflicts with RSHLib** (underlying issue between CCL and RSHLib, cannot be fixed).
- **Multiplayer**: Only basic support – some features (like minigames) may not work properly in multiplayer.
- **Adult Content**: Contains extreme violence, self-harm, sexual themes, harmful substances – you must be 18+ and enable adult content filtering.
- **Natural Spawning**: All items have `SpawnFrequency` set and will appear in the game world normally.

---

## 🚧 Future Plans

- Complete remaining unimplemented features.
- Improve multiplayer compatibility (as much as possible).
- Add more "Gouxi-Tech" themed items and events.

---

## 🙏 Credits

Thanks to all testers and the author of `CUCoreLib`. Have fun, and please don't hate Gouxi because of this mod (laughs).



# gouxi's funnyshit – 狗曦的乐色堆

> 一些来自 G0ux1 的奇怪点子，希望你们能享受。所有物品均已在游戏中配置自然刷新，部分内容还在完善中，后续会持续更新。

---

## 📦 模组内容概览

本模组为《Scav Prototype》添加了大量全新物品、液体和机制，涵盖装备、食物、医疗、工具、武器、实用道具以及多种特殊液体。所有内容均围绕“Gouxi-Tech”宇宙风格设计，带有恶搞、黑色幽默和一定程度的成人向内容。

### 🎒 装备类
- **尾包** – 可穿戴容器，增加负重上限，减少负重惩罚。
- **郊狼?!** – 可穿戴设备，可稳定心率，也能当作 AED 使用（需对胸部部使用）。
- **亚空间背包** – 超大容量背包，内置护盾，但电池耗尽时有湮灭风险。

### 🍖 食物类
- **生鱼** – 来自异维度的生鱼，吃了会拉肚子。
- **熟牛排** – 口感奇怪的完美煎牛排，能恢复大量饱食度和快乐值。

### 💊 医疗类
- **金苹果** – 大幅恢复内外伤，增加快乐值。
- **神经阻断中和剂** – 解除“记忆阻断”后遗症，使用后会强制高质量睡眠并重置智力。

### ⚒️ 工具/武器（三阶升级）
- **石制工具**（镐、剑、斧、锄、铲）– 基础采集与战斗。
- **铁制工具** – 更高耐久和伤害。
- **钻石制工具** – 顶级属性，附带截肢功能（对感染肢体使用可触发截肢小游戏）。

- **打火石** – 生火工具。
- **钓竿** – 抛出后回收可拉拽玩家并概率钓到鱼（经验修补）。

### 🧩 实用/杂项
- **脑机超频** – 提升移速、跳跃力，但损伤脑部。
- **系列玩偶（狗曦、黑白狼、槐梦、邪修、影狐、狐狸等）** – 可互动，产生各种效果（如增加快乐、降低体力、收集奇怪液体等）。
- **火焰弹** – 投掷后爆炸，带音效。
- **经验瓶** – 砸碎后获得大量经验并解锁随机配方。
- **核弹（两种）** – 一枚直接引爆，另一枚需完成拆弹小游戏（密码 `114514` 触发彩蛋奖励）。
- **芯片移除/植入器** – 控制“芯片”状态，影响脑部属性和能力。
- **吃吃爆** – 随机生成食物或爆炸（25%概率）。
- **EXP摸摸卷** – 对头部使用可增加快乐、减轻疼痛。
- **莹石粉、金锭、铁锭、钻石、木棍** – 合成材料。
- **俄罗斯轮盘赌** – 对头部使用，六分之一概率完全恢复，否则即死（带耐久消耗）。

### 🧪 液体容器
- **铁桶** – 可装任何液体并饮用。
- **药水瓶子** – 默认装填“瞬间治疗II”药水。
- **迷你桶注射器** – 超大容量注射器，对肢体使用会触发注射小游戏，效果强力但伴随严重副作用（大出血、骨折、脑损伤等）。

### 🌊 特殊液体（可饮用/注射）
- **血清素** – 注射后调节情绪，过量会产生抑郁。
- **瞬间治疗II** – 口服或外用/注射，快速恢复皮肤、肌肉、减少感染。
- **牛奶?（疑似）** – 饮用恢复饥渴但增加疾病，注射会感染。
- **橙汁汽水？** – 好喝但会引起不适。
- **昏睡红茶** – 饮用后极度快乐，短暂延迟后强制睡眠（带剧烈疼痛）。

---

## 🔧 特殊机制

- **截肢系统**：使用剑/斧类武器对感染严重的肢体（非腿部）可触发截肢小游戏。
- **核弹拆弹小游戏**：输入正确密码（正常随机生成）可延迟引爆，输入彩蛋密码 `114514` 则直接获得奖励。
- **郊狼 AED 功能**：对胸部使用可启动心脏复苏小游戏。
- **血清素动态平衡**：注射量影响快乐值和负面效果，过量会重置。
- **俄罗斯轮盘赌**：动态概率（随使用次数降低生存率），耐久消耗为 1/6。

---

## ⚠️ 注意事项

- **兼容性**：本模组基于 `CUCoreLib` 开发，**与 RSHLib 存在冲突**（这是 CCL 与 RSHLib 的底层问题，无法修复）。
- **多人联机**：仅提供最基础的支持，部分功能（如小游戏）可能无法在联机环境下正常工作。
- **成人内容**：模组包含极端暴力、自残、性暗示、有害物质等元素，请确保您已年满 18 岁并开启成人内容过滤。
- **自然刷新**：所有物品均已配置 `SpawnFrequency`，会在游戏世界中正常刷新。

---

## 🚧 未来计划

- 补全剩余未实装内容。
- 优化联机兼容性（尽力而为）。
- 增加更多“Gouxi-Tech”系列道具和事件。

---

## 🙏 致谢

感谢所有测试者和 `CUCoreLib` 的作者。祝您玩得开心，也希望您不要因为模组内容而讨厌狗曦（笑）。

Name: Bark

[url=https://github.com/CNCUMC/Bark]GitHub[/url] | [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/362]NexusMods[/url] | [url=https://github.com/jimmyking9999999/CUCoreLib]CUCoreLib[/url]

[i]A mod utility library for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3624440/Casualties_Unknown_Demo/]Casualties Unknown[/url], built on top of [url=https://github.com/jimmyking9999999/CUCoreLib]CUCoreLib[/url].[/i]

[i]Evolved from [url=https://github.com/Explosive-Hydra/Moss-Lib]Moss Lib[/url].[/i]

[line]
[size=4]Table of Contents[/size]

[list]
[*][url=#overview]Overview[/url][/*]
[*][url=#installation]Installation[/url][/*]
[*][url=#quick-start]Quick Start[/url][/*]
[*][url=#license]License[/url][/*]
[/list][line]
[size=4]Overview[/size]

[b]Bark[/b] is a BepInEx plugin utility library for [b]Casualties Unknown[/b], extending [url=https://github.com/jimmyking9999999/CUCoreLib]CUCoreLib[/url] (CCL) with enhanced localization, settings, and game utility tools.

[line]
[size=4]Installation[/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx]BepInEx 5.x[/url] for Casualties Unknown.[/*]
[*]Install [url=https://github.com/jimmyking9999999/CUCoreLib]CUCoreLib[/url] 1.0.2
place [font=Monaco,Consolas,'Lucida Console','Courier New',serif]CUCoreLib.dll[/font] into [font=Monaco,Consolas,'Lucida Console','Courier New',serif]BepInEx/plugins/CUCoreLib/[/font].[/*]
[*]Download the latest [font=Monaco,Consolas,'Lucida Console','Courier New',serif]Bark.dll[/font] from the [url=https://github.com/CNCUMC/Bark/releases]Releases[/url] page.[/*]
[*]Place [font=Monaco,Consolas,'Lucida Console','Courier New',serif]Bark.dll[/font] into your [font=Monaco,Consolas,'Lucida Console','Courier New',serif]BepInEx/plugins/[/font] folder.[/*]
[/list][quote][b]For mod developers:[/b] Reference [font=Monaco,Consolas,'Lucida Console','Courier New',serif]Bark.dll[/font] in your project, and add [font=Monaco,Consolas,'Lucida Console','Courier New',serif][BepInDependency("org.cucnmc.bark")][/font] to your
plugin class.[/quote][line]
[size=4]Quick Start[/size]

[size=3]1. Add Dependencies[/size]

[code][BepInPlugin(Guid, Name, Version)]
[BepInDependency("net.cucorelib")]    // CCL is required
[BepInDependency("org.cucnmc.bark")]  // Bark extends CCL
public class MyPlugin : BaseUnityPlugin
{
// ...
}[/code][size=3]2. Localization[/size]

Bark provides [font=Monaco,Consolas,'Lucida Console','Courier New',serif]BetterLocale[/font] on top of CCL [font=Monaco,Consolas,'Lucida Console','Courier New',serif]LocaleRegistry[/font]:

[code]using Bark.BetterCCL;

// Get localized text (CCL Bark defaults key fallback)
string text = BetterLocale.GetOther("bark.feature.enabled");

// Define fallback translations via language generators:
// EnLangGenerator.cs
Other("bark.feature.enabled", "Enable Feature");

// ZhCnLangGenerator.cs
Other("bark.feature.enabled", "启用功能");[/code]See [url=Example/Lang/]Example/Lang/[/url] for sample generators.

[size=3]3. Register a Setting[/size]

[code]using Bark.BetterCCL;

BetterOptions.Bool("bark", "feature_enabled", Setting.SettingCategory.Game, true);

// With custom category tab
BetterOptions.Bool("bark", "advanced_mode", "Bark", false);[/code][size=3]4. Check for Updates[/size]

[code]using Bark.Tool;

// Call in Awake() async, results output to logger + game console
UpdateUtil.Check("YourName/YourRepo", "YourMod", "1.0.0", Logger);[/code][line]
For detailed information, see [url=https://github.com/CNCUMC/Bark/blob/master/README.md]README.md[/url].
[line]

Name: MistalCry's Map
Description:
[b]中文/English[/b]
MistalCrysMap 是一个给 Casualties Unknown Demo 使用的轻量地图模组，提供小地图和大地图功能，方便探索、回路、寻找资源和避开危险。

[size=5]主要功能：[/size]
[list]
[*]显示小地图和大地图[/*]
[*]支持探索迷雾模式[/*]
[*]显示可交互资源、陷阱、商人、怪物、掉落物和 长老[/*]
[*]大地图顶部可以单独开关不同类别的标记[/*]
[*]支持鼠标中键放置导航标记，并显示玩家到标记点的指示线[/*]
[*]玩家位置带呼吸光圈，更容易在大地图上找到自己[/*]
[*]可选显示游戏对象自带精灵图，默认关闭[/*]
[*]大地图新增Center按钮，可直接把视角居中到玩家当前位置。（也可以按键盘home键）[/*]
[/list][size=4]如果不开精灵图，图标会这样显示：[/size]
[list]
[*]可交互的物体和容器显示为较亮的灰蓝色方块。[/*]
[*]交易者以绿色的 `$` 标记显示。[/*]
[*]敌人以红色小方块显示，其标记位置会随着移动而变化。[/*]
[*]荆棘背长老作为独立的boss标记显示，并可在大地图上单独切换。[/*]
[*]掉落物品以持续的黄色点显示。[/*]
[/list][size=5]默认操作：[/size]
[size=4]你可以在设置里的游戏玩法（gameplay），更改默认按钮、是否开启探索模式、小地图的形状和大小[/size]
[list]
[*]M：显示或隐藏小地图，打开大地图时用于关闭大地图[/*]
[*]右键点击小地图：打开大地图[/*]
[*]滚轮：缩放地图[/*]
[*]大地图右键拖动：平移地图[/*]
[*]中键点击地图：放置或更新导航标记[/*]
[*]Clear Mark：删除导航标记[/*]
[/list][size=5]安装方法：[/size]
需要 BepInEx。
把 MistalCrysMap.dll 放入 BepInEx/plugins 文件夹，然后启动游戏即可。
设置项可以在游戏 Settings -> Game 中找到。


[size=4][b]English Description[/b][/size]
MistalCrysMap is a lightweight map mod for Casualties Unknown Demo. It adds a minimap and a fullscreen map to make exploration, navigation, resource hunting, and danger awareness easier.
[size=5]Features:[/size]
[list]
[*]Adds a minimap and a fullscreen map[/*]
[*]Optional exploration fog mode[/*]
[*]Shows interactable resources, traps, traders, enemies, dropped items, and thornbackelder[/*]
[*]Fullscreen map category toggles[/*]
[*]Middle mouse waypoint marker with a guidance line from the player to the marker[/*]
[*]Breathing halo around the player marker for better visibility[/*]
[*]Optional sprite icons for map markers, disabled by default[/*]
[*]Performance optimizations for enemy-heavy layers, earthquakes, and block destruction updates[/*]
[*]The main map has added a "Center" button, which enables you to directly center the view at the player's current location. (You can also press the home key on the keyboard) [/*]
[/list][size=4][b]If the sprite image is not enabled, the icon will be displayed like this:[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]- Interactable objects and containers are shown as brighter gray-blue squares.[/*]
[*]- Traders are shown as green `$` markers.[/*]
[*]- Crystal enemies and animal enemies are shown as small red squares and their marker position follows movement.[/*]
[*]- Thornback Elder is shown as its own boss marker and can be toggled separately on the large map.[/*]
[*]- Dropped items are shown as persistent yellow dots.[/*]
[/list][size=5]Default Controls:[/size]
[size=4]You can change the default buttons, whether to enable the exploration mode, the shape and size of the mini-map, etc. in the "Gameplay" section of the settings.[/size]
[list]
[*]M: Show or hide the minimap, or close the fullscreen map[/*]
[*]Right click minimap: Open fullscreen map[/*]
[*]Mouse wheel: Zoom map[/*]
[*]Right drag on fullscreen map: Pan map[/*]
[*]Middle click on map: Place or update waypoint marker[/*]
[*]Clear Mark: Remove waypoint marker[/*]
[/list][size=5]Installation:[/size]
Requires BepInEx.
Put MistalCrysMap.dll into the BepInEx/plugins folder, then start the game.
Settings can be found under Settings -> GamePlay.

Name: Potato's Craft Everything MOD
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[left][color=#D4D4D8]I've done some no loot runs, which basically means I couldn't get uncraftable items in the game. The whole point of the run was crafting what you needed, and I was sad to see that there wasn't many craftables, so, using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/125]CraftingFramework[/url], I was able to add more crafting recipes` to the usually uncraftable items![/color]

Although I've tried my best, I'm not the best at balancing. If you think something is overpriced or underpriced in the game, tell me what you'd like me to change! (I want to keep this as balanced as possible.)

Note: If a "NO LOOT" run sounds interesting to you, I'd recommend you install this mod so you can craft everything and alongside that, install the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/409]Too Many Settings[/url] mod so you can disable mini-barrel spawns.

EVERYONE must have the mod for it to work in multiplayer.

If you want a specific item craftable, even a mod item, just comment. I'm down to do most stuff unless the thing you want me to make craftable is troubling in some way.
Also, if you think something is WAY to easy/hard to craft, please comment! I want this mod to be fun for everyone! Even if you think maybe your comment might be wrong, I love to consider these things and it gives me more things to do rather than rot away in my bed :3

Also, commenting on this project will get me working on it, otherwise my brain goes "Haha, no one like mod." Then I get all lazy cuz of it. You know, everyday things!

[ ! MOD IS IN A WORK IN PROGRESS ! ]

(As of v0.5) Currently only adds crafting for:
Arm Warmers, Automated External Defibrillator, Auto-Zoom Goggles,  Balaclava, Bandolier, Belly Armor, Blindfold, Braingrow, Carapace, Cardboard Box, Circuit Board, Dust Mask, Electronic Watch, Fanny Pack, Filter Straw, Grappling Hook, Grav-Bag, Heroin, Holiday Hat, Jetpack, Knee Pads, Latex Gloves, Leg Pouch, Liquid Centrifuge, Manual Defibrillator, Medkit, Mindwipe, Mp3 Player, Pistol, Plastic Bag, Pouch, Pump Action Shotgun, Purse, Rifle, Ripped Bag, Safety Glasses, Sleeping Bag, Small Backpack, Sneakers, Space Drain, Toolbox, Torn Shirt, Trash Bag, Plasma Cutter, Claw Pack, Climbing Claws, Sledgehammer, Big Flesh Chunk, Wooden Trowel, Trowel, Wooden Digging Tool, Metal Digging Tool, and Wooden Pickaxe.

MAY INCLUDE MODDED ITEMS IN THE FUTURE [ Note: You will still be able to run the mod, even if you don't have those modded items. ][/left]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]1. Install and setup [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/125]CraftingFramework[/url].
2. Locate the crafting framework file and click on it.
3. Drag and drop the contents of this mod into the recipes folder. (If updating the mod, click replace.)
4. Boot up the game and start a run!
[/color]
(Can't download from nexus? Download from [url=https://github.com/skyfire1234567/CraftEverything/releases/tag/idk]github[/url]!)

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Makes almost all uncraftable items craftable.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Install CraftingFramework[/color]

Name: Kizu's Tacticool
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Kizu's Tacticool - Normal Edition[/b][/size][/center]
[color=#D4D4D8]
[size=3]An addon for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/122?tab=description][b]This[/b][/url] mod. It adds a few modern guns inspired by real guns I thought was cool. The first version was kind of all over the place playability wise, so I decided to try to keep things less miserable to manage. A few of the guns use already existing mags, like the vanilla pistol mags, while another uses internal magazines, letting you get away with carrying loose rounds. The guns that are using their "Proprietary" magazines just serves as a base for new guns I might be adding in the future, meaning rifle A uses a PMAG, while rifle B also uses the PMAG.[/size]


[size=5][b]The Guns[/b][/size][/color]

[spoiler][b]- Ren Industries Mk15 
[/b]An AR-15 rifle sold to the civilian market. Shoots 5.56 in semi-auto only. Uses KalPul MMAGs

[b]- Ren Industries Mk15C
[/b]Sold by survivors. The shorter version of the Mk15. The trader also found a few attachments and a suppressor to go with it. Your ears will thank you.

[b]- Ren Industries Scout[/b]
A simple bolt action 5.56 rifle. Uses its 5 round internal magazines instead of detachable magazines. 

[b]- Kazorov Avtomat
[/b][i]The Assault Rifle.[/i] Shoots 7.62x39mm and takes a lot to break. Uses Kazorov Magazines.

[b]- Kazorov Simonov
[/b]A really old semi auto service rifle. Shoots 7.62x39mm from its 10 round internal magazine.

[b]- Sakura Tanto[/b]
A compact competition pistol using the vanilla pistol mags. Has close to no recoil thanks to its muzzle brake. Plus, it looks cool.[/spoiler]

[spoiler][size=4][b][i]In the case when you want to spawn them in using the console
[/i][/b][/size]
[code]kazorovavtomat=Kazorov Avtomat
kazorovsimonov=Kazorov Simonov
ren15=Ren Industries Mk15
ren15c=Ren Industries Mk15C
renscout=Ren Industries Scout
sakuratanto=Sakura Tanto
pmag=KalPul MMAG
akm=Kazorov Magazine
762rus=7.62x39mm
762pouch=A pouch containing 7.62x39mm[/code][/spoiler]



[center][size=6][b]Kizu's Tacticool - Fun Slop Edition

[img]https://i.imgur.com/YgzJKfw.jpeg[/img][/b][/size][/center]
[left][/left]
Yes, it's unbalanced as hell, but it's fun. This version of the mod just contains whatever guns I like with zero balancing whatsoever. Every gun shares the same magazine (except one), every gun shoots .999 Whatever (No, literally.) And everything in this version of the mod can be crafted with a single piece of [b]Foliage[/b].
[b]
[size=4]Play with Pixelated Rendering off to appreciate the sprite.[/size][/b] 

[b][size=5]The Guns[/size]
[/b]
[spoiler][b]- M4A1 URGI[/b]
Come on, you'd always want to have this in any game with a gun nowadays.

[b]- MCX Spear LT 5.56[/b]
SIG's third generation of the MCX, borrows some features from the Army's XM7. This one is the 16.5 inch variant.

[b]- M110K5[/b]
The shorter version of the M110. Kind of a battle rifle with an identity crisis.

[b]- Westernized AK74M
[/b]Most of the things on it comes from the west. The only thing that's Russian is its magazine and lower receiver. Though, now it looks kind of cooler, depending on who you ask.

[b]- Denel NTW-20[/b]
Because of logistical constraints and the nature of this behemoth, you're forced to single load it, instead of feeding it through its magazine. Your ears might implode when shooting this.
[/spoiler]

[spoiler][b][i][size=4]In the case when you want to spawn them in using the console[/size]
[/i][/b]
m4urgi=M4A1 URGI
ak74mod=Westernized AK74M
m110k5=M110K5
mcxslt=MCX Spear LT 5.56
ntw20=Denel NTW-20
wtv999=.999 Whatever
mpmag=mags for most of the guns. Magic PMAG
mlancer=mags for the M110K5[/spoiler]

[b]P.S

[/b]The sprites of the guns in the fun version are mainly leftovers to when I used to mod another game. Their quality may vary.

[color=#D4D4D8][size=3][b]1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/122?tab=description]New Firearms
[/url][/b][/size][/color][color=#b6b6b6][size=3][b]2. Extract the contents of my file in  /BepinEx/plugins
[/b][/size][/color]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[size=2]Provides a more intelligent system for choosing crafting materials, and for storing crafted items.[/size]


[img]https://github.com/BalaurBohemianBroken/cu-better-inventory-logic/blob/master/PageImages/cu-features.png?raw=true[/img]
[size=2]• Choose suitable crafting materials based on quality, condition, value.[/size]

[img]https://github.com/BalaurBohemianBroken/cu-better-inventory-logic/blob/master/PageImages/cu-installation.png?raw=true[/img]
[size=2]Same dealio as most mods. BepInEx, place .dll in plugins.[/size]
[size=2]BepInEx install steps:[/size]
[spoiler][color=#D4D4D8][size=2]1. Download [/size][/color][color=#8e7cc3][size=2][font=Courier New][b]BepInEx_win_x64[/b][/font][/size][/color][color=#D4D4D8][size=2] (even if you're on [/size][/color][color=#ff00ff][size=2]Linux[/size][/color][color=#D4D4D8][size=2]) from their [url=https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx/releases]releases[/url]. I used version [/size][/color][color=#8e7cc3][size=2][b]5.4.23.4[/b][/size][/color][color=#D4D4D8][size=2].

2. Unzip the file contents into the root folder of the game. In the same directory as the [/size][/color][color=#8e7cc3][size=2][b].exe[/b][/size][/color][color=#D4D4D8][size=2] file, there should be a [/size][/color][color=#8e7cc3][size=2][b]winhttp.dll[/b][/size][/color][color=#D4D4D8][size=2] file if you've done it right.

2.5. [/size][/color][size=2][b][color=#ff00ff]Linux users[/color][/b][color=#D4D4D8][b]:[/b] Add the following command to your launch options, on steam found in Properties > General > Launch Options: [/color][b][color=#6d9eeb][font=Courier New]WINEDLLOVERRIDES="winhttp=n,b" %command%[/font][/color][/b][color=#D4D4D8]

3. Launch the game. This will initialize BepInEx. If it worked, in Casualties Unknown Demo > BepInEx, there should exist a [/color][color=#8e7cc3][b]plugins[/b][/color][color=#D4D4D8] folder.[/color][/size][/spoiler]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=2]From there, place the provided [/size][/color][color=#8e7cc3][size=2][b].dll[/b][/size][/color][color=#D4D4D8][size=2] file into [b]BepInEx/plugins[/b][/size][/color]


[img]https://github.com/BalaurBohemianBroken/cu-better-inventory-logic/blob/master/PageImages/cu-feature-ideas.png?raw=true[/img]
[size=2]• Automatically craft prerequisites for recipes.[/size]
[size=2]• Multiplayer support......[/size]

[size=2]• Craft using mixed liquids first.[/size]
[size=2]• Top off bottles that are partially filled, and move on to filling a new bottle with the remainder of a recipe.[/size]
[size=2]• Allow recipes to use containers (like bags) which have items in them, with a warning.[/size]
[size=2]• Show more information about input and output items in crafting menu[/size]
[size=2]• Rearranging the sorting stack, to choose what is the most important factor to you.[/size]


[img]https://github.com/BalaurBohemianBroken/cu-better-inventory-logic/blob/master/PageImages/cu-compatibility.png?raw=true[/img]

[b][color=#8e7cc3][size=4]Bug reporting[/size][/color][/b]
[size=2]There may be bugs I haven't noticed! I've hit a rogue wave of depression and haven't been able to do thorough testing. If you find a bug, let me know and I'll try to fix it quickly. Guide for that:[/size]
[spoiler][size=2]The more information is provided, the quicker developers are able to address the issue!
Any information is always better than no information. Even if you can't get much, making any post may help.[/size]
[size=2]Bug reports should go into the [b]Bugs[/b] section of the mod page.

[b]Description[/b] - Details of what was expected to happen, and what happened instead. Any information that might suggest what the cause is. It can't be fixed if we don't know what the issue is!

[b]Replicability[/b] - If you can give steps to reliably reproduce the issue, that's the most helpful thing! It makes it quick to verify the issue and test fixes.

[b]Existing bug reports[/b] - Try to check if there's already been a report of this bug. You could add more information to that report, or find an explanation of what's going on.

[b]Game version[/b] - This can be seen on the main menu in the bottom right. Code can change a lot between versions!

[b]Log file[/b] - This is located in {game_folder}/BepInEx/LogOutput.log. It provides a list of your mods and their versions, which are very helpful for tracking down the issue!

[b]Updating[/b] - Try to make sure your mods and game are up to date, especially the mod that has the bug. It might have been changed, or fixed.

Modding is not simple work, and most of us do this for free out of passion in our spare time. Be considerate. It might take time to fix things.[/size][/spoiler]

Name: Performance Unknown
Description:
[size=6][b]Performance Unknown[/b][/size]

An advanced, hardware-aligned performance and memory allocation optimization BepInEx mod for [b]Casualties Unknown[/b]. It tackles major Unity-specific bottlenecks (heavy line-of-sight raycasting, dynamic 2D physics solvers, memory allocation stutters, and splatter particle spam) and exposes high-level, human-readable quality adjustments directly inside the official native Video Settings menu using the [font=Courier New][url=https://github.com/NaeNaeTart/ScavSetLib]ScavSetLib[/url][/font] API.

[line]

[size=5][b]🚀 Key Features & Optimizations[/b][/size]

[list]
[*] [b]📷 LOS Refresh Amortization:[/b] Skips Line-of-Sight raycast loops in [font=Courier New]LateUpdate[/font] across multiple frames based on dynamic settings, yielding a [b]50% - 75% reduction in CPU overhead[/b] with zero visual compromise.[/*]
[*][b]🩸 Splatter Particle Ceiling:[/b] Implements an active FIFO-pruning system on visual blood splatters, dust, debris, and explosions to prevent combat framerate drops and massive rendering bottlenecks.[/*]
[*][b]⚙️ Physics 2D Solver Tuning:[/b] Dynamically adjusts Box2D position and velocity solver iterations, [b]drastically speeding up crowded scenes[/b] with multiple active NPCs, ragdolls, or items.[/*]
[*][b]🧹 Stutter-Free Garbage Collection (GC):[/b] Allocates incremental GC timeslices to split heap sweeps across frames, and executes preemptive safe garbage sweeping when entering paused states or loading scenes to eliminate micro-stutters.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]📊 Native Video Settings Integration[/b][/size]

Through the power of [font=Courier New][url=https://github.com/NaeNaeTart/ScavSetLib]ScavSetLib[/url][/font], all configurations are integrated directly into the game's official native Video Settings menu, enabling fluid in-game changes without restart:







[table][tr][td][b]Setting Name[/b][/td]
[td][b]Category[/b][/td]
[td][b]Choices / Defaults[/b][/td]
[td][b]Optimization Vector[/b][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]LOS Refresh Interval[/b][/td]
[td]Video[/td]
[td][font=Courier New]Every Frame[/font] / [font=Courier New]Every 2 Frames[/font] (Fast) / [font=Courier New]Every 3 Frames[/font] (Ultra) / [font=Courier New]Every 4 Frames[/font][/td]
[td]Amortizes line-of-sight raycasts to skip intensive trigonometry calculations.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]Splatter Particle Cap[/b][/td]
[td]Video[/td]
[td][font=Courier New]25[/font] / [font=Courier New]50[/font] / [font=Courier New]100[/font] (Balanced) / [font=Courier New]200[/font] / [font=Courier New]Unlimited[/font][/td]
[td]Active FIFO-limiting of splatters and visual particles.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]Physics 2D Solver Quality[/b][/td]
[td]Video[/td]
[td][font=Courier New]Low[/font] / [font=Courier New]Medium[/font] (Optimized) / [font=Courier New]High[/font] (Default)[/td]
[td]Tunes velocity and position solver iterations.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]GC Memory Sweeper[/b][/td]
[td]Video[/td]
[td][font=Courier New]Enabled[/font] (Default) / [font=Courier New]Disabled[/font][/td]
[td]Tunes incremental GC timeslices and sweeps on safe events.[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
[line]

[size=5][b]🛠️ Requirements & Installation[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*] Ensure you have [b][url=https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx]BepInEx[/url][/b] (5.x or later) installed for the game.[/*]
[*]Ensure you have [b][url=https://github.com/NaeNaeTart/ScavSetLib]ScavSetLib[/url][/b] (1.0.0 or later) installed in your [font=Courier New]BepInEx/plugins[/font] folder.[/*]

[line]
[b][color=#f39c12][size=5]What Is CUCoreLib?[/size][/color][/b]

CUCoreLib is an [b]exhaustive shared modding library and documentation project[/b] for Casualties: Unknown, built for both [b]beginners[/b] and [b]veteran mod authors[/b].

Instead of every mod reinventing the same systems over and over, CUCoreLib provides a common foundation, with documentation.

[color=#74b9ff][b]We have:[/b][/color]
[list]
[*]A human-written shared framework for building mods faster[/*]
[*]A safer compatibility layer for future modding work and multi-mod compatibility (it works with QoL and Multiplayer off the bat!)[/*]
[*]A very well documented API surface with examples and videos ([url=https://cucorelib.jimmyking.dev]cucorelib.jimmyking.dev[/url])[/*]
[*]A open-source project intended to grow with community feedback and contributions[/*]
[*]Hot loading, so you don't have to close your game every time you want to update your mod (!!)[/*]
[/list]
[color=#f39c12][size=5][b]What Does It Provide?[/b][/size][/color]

[color=#ffeaa7][b]Core library features[/b][/color]
[list]
[*]Helper functions and shared utility systems[/*]
[*]Publicized access to useful private game data[/*]
[*]Mod-compatible patch hooks[/*]
[*]Documentation through an external webapp with examples, references, and videos[/*]
[*]Makes modding much faster and streamlined, with hot reloading[/*]
[/list][color=#ffeaa7][b]In-game modular API support[/b][/color]
[list]
[*]Custom items, liquids, containers, weapons, crafting materials, drops, and more[/*]
[*]Equipment[/*]
[*]Moodles and custom status effects[/*]
[*]Crafting and recipes[/*]
[*]Console commands[/*]
[*]Automatic locale and translation support[/*]
[*]Settings menu support[/*]
[*]Saving and persistent mod data[/*]
[*]Custom world entities, tiles, traps, and interactables[/*]
[*]Multiplayer API and helpers[/*]
[*]Custom minigame and animation support via assetbundle loading[/*]
[*]XML documentation and normal documentation[/*]
[*]General utility systems for mod authors[/*]
[/list]
[color=#f39c12][size=5][b]Why Use It?[/b][/size][/color]

A lot of mods need the same basic foundation:
[list]
[*]Loading custom assets[/*]
[*]Registering items, liquids, recipes, and world content[/*]
[*]Saving mod data safely[/*]
[*]Patching game systems without exploding on updates[/*]
[*]Staying compatible with other mods[/*]
[*]Handling multiplayer-related integration[/*]
[/list]
Without a shared library, every mod author ends up building their own version of the same systems. That makes mods harder to maintain, harder to update, more likely to conflict, and more annoying to extend later.

[center][color=#55efc4]CUCoreLib aims to become a common framework the modding scene can build on together.[/color][/center]

[center][color=#ff7675][b]! This library is fully open source and open to pull requests! ![/b][/color][/center]

Name: ScavSetLib
Description:
[size=6][b][url=https://github.com/NaeNaeTart/ScavSetLib]ScavSetLib[/url] ([url=https://github.com/NaeNaeTart/ScavSetLib]ScavSettingsLib[/url]) — Official API Reference[/b][/size]

[font=Courier New][url=https://github.com/NaeNaeTart/ScavSetLib]ScavSetLib[/url][/font] is an independent, highly optimized class library/API designed for BepInEx mod developers of [b]Casualties Unknown[/b]. It allows mods to register custom settings (Dropdowns, Floats, Integers, or Booleans) directly inside the game's official menus (Video, Audio, Game, etc.) with native styling, native sliders, native toggle switches, and fully automatic loading, saving, and localization lookup overrides.

[line]

[size=5][b]1. Core Technical Architecture[/b][/size]

The library bypasses the need for every developer to write redundant Harmony patches on the game's settings template lists and [font=Courier New]Locale[/font] translations. Instead, it runs a single centralized patch system that dynamically polls custom setting definitions and resolves their visual naming at runtime.

[b]System Workflow:[/b]
[code]
Mod Developers
  │
  └── (Call Register API) ──> SettingsManager
                                │
                                └──> Populates Definitions & Localizations
                                      │
                                      └──> Registry Maps
                                              │
      ┌──────────────────────────────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────┐
      ▼                                      ▼                                      ▼
Settings.DefaultSettings Postfix      Settings.EnsureLoaded Postfix          Locale.GetString Prefix
(Hook Default Templates)              (Hook Live Settings)                  (Hook Localization)
      │                                      │                                      │
      ▼                                      ▼                                      ▼
Instantiates Custom Settings          Instantiates / Syncs Settings          Overrides 'gameset' strings
      │                                      │                                      │
      └──────────────────────────────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────┘
                                              ▼
                                    Game's Native UI Renderer[/code]
[line]

[size=5][b]2. API Structuring[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]2.1 Supported Setting Types[/b][/size]
[list]
[*] [b]Dropdowns ([font=Courier New]SettingDropdown[/font]):[/b] Selection menus with clean option labels.[/*]
[*][b]Float Sliders ([font=Courier New]SettingFloat[/font]):[/b] Float values with customizable range (min/max) and string formatting (e.g. percentages, decimals).[/*]
[*][b]Integer Sliders ([font=Courier New]SettingInt[/font]):[/b] Integer step-based ranges (min/max).[/*]
[*][b]Toggle Switches ([font=Courier New]SettingBool[/font]):[/b] Standard true/false checkboxes.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]2.2 Base Setting Definition[/b][/size]
All setting types inherit from a base definition class that populates core fields such as internal name, category (Video, Audio, Game, Input, Language), and synchronizes values when modified elsewhere.

[code]
public abstract class SettingDefinition
{
    public string Name { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public Setting.SettingCategory Category { get; set; }
    public string CleanName { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    public abstract Setting CreateSettingInstance();
    public abstract void SyncValueFromSource(Setting setting);
}[/code]
[line]

[size=5][b]3. How to Use [url=https://github.com/NaeNaeTart/ScavSetLib]ScavSetLib[/url] in Your Mod[/b][/size]

[b]Step 1: Declare the BepInEx Dependency[/b]
Ensure BepInEx is aware that your mod depends on [font=Courier New][url=https://github.com/NaeNaeTart/ScavSetLib]ScavSetLib[/url][/font] so it loads in the correct order:
[code]
[BepInPlugin("com.yourname.yourmod", "YourMod", "1.0.0")]
[BepInDependency("com.kanisuko.scavsetlib")]
public class YourPlugin : BaseUnityPlugin
{
    // ...
}[/code]
[b]Step 2: Register Settings inside [font=Courier New]Awake()[/font][/b]
To inject custom settings, call the static [font=Courier New][url=https://github.com/NaeNaeTart/ScavSetLib]ScavSetLib[/url].SettingsManager[/font] registration methods during initialization.

[code]
using ScavSetLib;

private void Awake()
{
    // 1. Register a Dropdown setting inside the native VIDEO category
    SettingsManager.RegisterDropdown(
        name: "MyCustomMode",
        category: Setting.SettingCategory.Video,
        choices: new string[] { "Off", "Low", "Ultra" },
        defaultValue: 0,
        onApply: (selectedVal) => {
            // Callback when modified in-game
            MyConfig.CustomMode.Value = selectedVal;
        },
        valueGetter: () => MyConfig.CustomMode.Value, // For active synchronization
        cleanName: "Ultra Visual Mode",              // Clean display label
        cleanChoiceNames: new string[] { "Disabled", "Standard Quality", "Extreme Ultra" } // Clean options
    );

    // 2. Register a Slider setting inside the native GAME category
    SettingsManager.RegisterFloat(
        name: "MyCustomSpeed",
        category: Setting.SettingCategory.Game,
        min: 0.5f,
        max: 2.0f,
        defaultValue: 1.0f,
        onApply: (speedVal) => {
            MyConfig.GameSpeed.Value = speedVal;
        },
        valueGetter: () => MyConfig.GameSpeed.Value,
        cleanName: "Simulation Velocity",
        formatValue: (val) => $"{val:F1}x" // Formats float slider label natively
    );
}[/code]
[line]

[size=5][b]4. Under the Hood Mechanics[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]4.1 Native UI Rendering Hooking[/b][/size]
When [font=Courier New]SettingsMenu.SelectTab(SettingCategory)[/font] is invoked, it instantiates option prefabs by looping through [font=Courier New]Settings.settings[/font]. Because [font=Courier New][url=https://github.com/NaeNaeTart/ScavSetLib]ScavSetLib[/url][/font] injects your settings directly into [font=Courier New]Settings.settings[/font] (and matches values loaded from save files), the game [b]automatically creates and renders native GameObjects[/b] (sliders, toggles, dropdown boxes) using its built-in styling, saving you hours of manual UI development!

[size=4][b]4.2 Bulletproof Localization Interception[/b][/size]
The game automatically prepends [font=Courier New]"gameset"[/font] to unregistered options when fetching localizations, which would normally result in broken text (e.g., [font=Courier New]"gamesetUltra Visual Mode"[/font]).

To prevent this, [font=Courier New][url=https://github.com/NaeNaeTart/ScavSetLib]ScavSetLib[/url][/font] intercepts [font=Courier New]Locale.GetString(string str, int type)[/font] with a [font=Courier New]HarmonyPrefix[/font] and does a high-performance O(1) dictionary lookup to immediately swap prefix strings:

[code]
[HarmonyPatch(typeof(Locale), "GetString")]
[HarmonyPrefix]
public static bool GetString_Prefix(string str, int type, ref string __result)
{
    if (str != null && SettingsManager.TryGetLocalization(str, out string localized))
    {
        __result = localized;
        return false; // Skip original game dictionary lookup
    }
    return true; // Default fallback for native game strings
}[/code]
This guarantees:
[list=1]
[*] [b]Dynamic Custom Labeling:[/b] Perfectly matches clean strings provided by developers.[/*]
[*][b]No Wrapping Anomalies:[/b] Choice items in dropdown lists display properly formatted text, eliminating ugly text wrapping.[/*]
[*][b]Zero Overhead:[/b] The dictionary check runs instantly and has negligible performance impact on original game translation files.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[quote][b]NOTE[/b]
[font=Courier New][url=https://github.com/NaeNaeTart/ScavSetLib]ScavSetLib[/url][/font] operates as a pure, standalone, dependency-free API, requiring only basic Unity/BepInEx libraries.[/quote]

A BepInEx mod for [b]Casualties Unknown[/b] that adds custom, fully-featured trading NPCs to the game. Complete with in-game developer console integration, autocompletion support, and built-in anti-exploit protection.

[size=5][b]👥 Meet the Traders[/b][/size]

This mod introduces three unique non-playable characters (NPCs) with custom trading inventories, names, and interaction behaviors:

[size=4][b]🩺 Dr. Hernandez (Medic)[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Role:[/b] Specialized medical supplier and practitioner.[/*]
[*][b]Service:[/b] Automatically restores your health to full when you initiate a trade with him.[/*]
[*][b]Inventory:[/b] Sells vital medical supplies, first-aid kits, and medicine to help you survive.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]🍳 Mama Cecile (Chef)[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Role:[/b] Culinary expert and restaurant owner.[/*]
[*][b]Service:[/b] Automatically satisfies your hunger and increases player satisfaction upon opening her trade menu.[/*]
[*][b]Inventory:[/b] Sells ingredients, canned goods, and home-cooked meals.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]🎲 Lucky (Gambler)[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Role:[/b] High-roller dealer.[/*]
[*][b]Service:[/b] Tests your luck with mystery boxes and lottery-style items.[/*]
[*][b]Inventory:[/b] Sells custom mystery boxes, game tickets, and unique high-risk high-reward items.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]💻 Console Commands & Autocomplete[/b][/size]

Spawn these traders instantly anywhere using the in-game developer console.






[table][tr][td][b]Command[/b][/td]
[td][b]Action[/b][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][i]spawnmedic[/i][/td]
[td]Spawns [b]Dr. Hernandez[/b] (Medic) at your current crosshair position.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][i]spawnchef[/i][/td]
[td]Spawns [b]Mama Cecile[/b] (Chef) at your current crosshair position.[/td]

[/tr]
[/table]
[size=4][b]⚡ Autocomplete Support[/b][/size]
Type [i]spawn[/i] in the developer console and press [i]Tab[/i] to quickly browse and auto-complete these commands!

[line]

[size=5][b]🛠️ Advanced Features[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]🛡️ Anti-Exploit State Tracker[/b][/size]
To prevent players from repeatedly opening and closing trading menus to infinitely heal or feed themselves, the mod includes a robust state tracking system:
[list]
[*][b]Interaction Cooldown:[/b] A trader's special status action (healing for Dr. Hernandez, feeding for Mama Cecile) will only trigger [b]once[/b] per spawn or per long interaction cycle.[/*]
[*][b]Fair Play:[/b] Closing and reopening the menu immediately on the same NPC will not re-trigger the benefit, keeping the game balanced.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]📥 Installation[/b][/size]

[list=1]

[i][Casualties Unknown Game Directory]/BepInEx/plugins/[/i][/*]

Name: LateJoinFix
Description:
### Late Join Fix

A small **optional** BepInEx plugin for **Casualties Unknown** multiplayer.

It is **not** a replacement for [Casualties Together](https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/67) — you must install Krokosha’s MP mod first. Late Join Fix only addresses **late-join session inventory**: players who join mid-run can receive the host’s session save **once**, without duplicate grants after disconnect/reconnect.

---

### Requirements

| Required | Notes |
|----------|--------|
| **Casualties Unknown** | Current Steam demo / game build |
| **BepInEx 5.x** | Included with Casualties Together setup |
| **[Casualties Together](https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/67)** | **v3.1.2** — by **Krokosha** |
| **All players** | Host and every client need this file |

**Hard dependency:** `KrokoshaCasualtiesMP` (Casualties Together).

---

### What it does

- Host archives per-player saves during the session (on save/load).
- **First-time** late joiners receive their session inventory snapshot when they spawn.
- Players who already received a grant, or left and rejoined the same session, do **not** get a second grant.
- Clears disconnect reconnect saves for players who already consumed their grant.

This is a **standalone, focused** release of the original community late-join save fix. It does **not** include layer unlocks, terrain changes, connection/Steam relay patches, or other gameplay overhauls.

---

### Installation

1. Install **[Casualties Together](https://www.nexusmods.com/scavprototype/mods/67)** (3.1.2) and confirm multiplayer works.
2. Extract so you have:
BepInEx/plugins/LateJoinFix/LateJoinFix.dll
3. Install on **host and all clients**.
4. Do **not** use alongside other late-join / session-save patches (only one such mod at a time).

---

### Compatibility

- Built for **Casualties Together 3.1.2** only.
- **Not** affiliated with, endorsed by, or maintained by **Krokosha** or the Casualties Unknown developers.
- Not a fork of Casualties Together — install it **in addition to** the MP mod.

---

### Credits

- Late-join session save logic — community fix for Casualties Together 3.1.2; this release is a standalone rebuild as **Late Join Fix**
- Nexus upload / maintenance — LYSJca

Name: Interactive Expie
Description:
[size=6][b]🐾 Expie Petting and Interaction Mod[/b][/size]

An interactive, high-fidelity physical and psychological BepInEx mod for [b]Casualties: Unknown[/b] that lets you interact with your experiment subject ("expie") like a beloved, physical pet.

This mod introduces custom physics dragging/tugging forces, petting gestures, comforting neurological benefits, a satiety-fatigue simulation, and highly reactive sensory feedback depending on the subject's physical state.

[line]

[size=5][b]✨ Features[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]1. 🧲 Physical Mouse Grabbing & Tugging[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Grab and Drag:[/b] Hold the configured modifier key (default: [i]Left Alt[/i]) and [b]Left-Click[/b] on any physical limb in the world to grab and drag it.[/*]
[*][b]Spring Physics:[/b] The grabbed limb is realistically pulled towards your mouse cursor using a fully physical 2D spring-damper calculation.[/*]
[*][b]Tug-to-Flop:[/b] Grabbing and dragging a limb while the subject is standing up temporarily makes [i]only that limb[/i] dynamic and floppy, allowing you to stretch or position it while the rest of the body maintains its standing animation.[/*]
[*][b]Strain Discomfort:[/b] Dragging limbs too far beyond their range or pulling on dislocated/broken parts causes immediate localized pain spikes, tension stretch sound effects, and distressed vocalizations.[/*]
[*][b]Anti-Flying Physics Ceiling:[/b] While the subject is ragdolled, dragging targets are dynamically clamped via a downward raycast checking the [i]"Ground"[/i] layer. You can drag and slide them horizontally across any platforms, ramps, or sloped surfaces, but lifting them high into the air is blocked, neutralizing the flying physics exploit.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]2. 🫳 Cozy Petting & Stroking[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Stroking Gesture Verification:[/b] Petting requires active hand-stroking movement above a customizable velocity threshold ([i]MinPettingSpeed[/i]). Simply hovering or holding your cursor stationary over a limb will not trigger petting.[/*]
[*][b]Soothing Neurological Benefits:[/b] Petting healthy limbs slowly heals active limb pain, increases overall character [i]happiness[/i], and reduces emotional [i]trauma/stress[/i].[/*]
[*][b]Micro-movements & Nuzzling:[/b] When petted on the head, the expie will physically lift and tilt their head into your cursor to simulate nuzzling.[/*]
[*][b]Happy Cooing:[/b] Healthy subjects express deep contentment through soft sighs, purrs, or high-pitched cozy whimpers.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]3. 🥱 Petting Saturation & Satiety[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Per-Body Satiety Tracking:[/b] Satiety levels are tracked independently for each specific Expie body instance, allowing you to interact with multiple subjects naturally.[/*]
[*][b]Comfort Fatigue:[/b] Over-petting causes the expie to gradually grow tired of physical contact. Satiety accumulates over continuous stroking.[/*]
[*][b]Diminishing Comfort Efficiency:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]0% to 50% Satiety:[/b] Full comfort and maximum mood boost efficiency.[/*]
[*][b]50% to 100% Satiety:[/b] Satiety sets in, smoothly scaling comfort and healing efficiency down to [i]0%[/i].[/*]
[*][b]100% Satiety (Over-stimulation):[/b] The expie is completely indifferent. No mood upgrades, pain relief, or happy vocalizations are triggered.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]Persistent Moodles & Decay:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Satiating Petting Moodle:[/b] Once satiety reaches [i]50%[/i], the light-green [color=#66ff66][i]Satiating Petting[/i][/color] moodle remains continuously visible on the HUD, even when you stop petting, until it slowly decays back below the [i]50%[/i] threshold.[/*]
[*][b]Permanent Indifference Moodle:[/b] Once satiety reaches [i]100%[/i] (indifference is triggered), it is permanently locked at [i]100%[/i] for that specific Expie body and never decays. The orange [color=#ff9933][i]Petting Satiety[/i][/color] moodle remains visible permanently on the HUD for that subject body.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]🩹 Sensory Pain & Wounded Reactions[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Hypersensitivity:[/b] Petting a body part with skin damage (active wounds or burns) triggers intense localized pain spikes, adrenaline shock surges, and a severe drop in happiness.[/*]
[*][b]Agonizing Vocalizations:[/b] Petting wounded parts triggers intense vocal screams and high-volume distress lines.[/*]
[*][b]Unconscious Spasms:[/b] Touching/petting active wounds on an [b]unconscious[/b] subject causes physical reflexes (sudden spasms/convulsive twitches) accompanied by low, painful groans.[/*]
[/list][line]
